name: Jim Jordan
subject: After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you!
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Peter!
| Peter,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.
---

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| | Friend, On Tuesday, Liberal Chris Taylor won the Wisconsin Supreme Court race by a massive margin. This means Democrats will now retain control of this critical swing state Supreme Court until at least 2030 dashing MAGA's hopes of stealing Wisconsin's electoral college votes in 2028.
Defend our Courts was proud to have played a role in this win. Now with this and the landslide Democratic win in the Pennsylvania Supreme Court election last fall, our record of defending key swing state courts targeted by MAGA is 2-0.
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BfqOdbWv32k8l7l_aycurijI4qv2CLNOM561Qf3JaQivWuG0H3S6kb3FXSY3gIHtu-vDCLqrm39vBP4LIkXpS6Ji3gfmFeEmTRCkSs9ydF-UBGBIXwDQ1u43LLQnutBGC0CDOb8EBgXW9yULjsRZuPj3wh0b1K5pypudKQB66w56fPhV-pggth7Dnb2hql_Ytzdgkt_WPXgoNf-VIQ6BeVNl8XWTZ14D0lZiiQyTrlFhdMEkuX1Jm54cTXwmm95Tgn5ZOcOu_ZM=&c=eWDwVCMlR7mhHSQRSNePweR2ZsDQPme2Jb6je4yvB2DMKu1ThEN4aA==&ch=S_6kO3dWNOPwI5jI_QRp6BYYfCnWPnj7eWqZ6sfmgQPPdLiFTl-T0Q==)
---
| | Our contribution to the Democratic effort in Wisconsin was to target over 1 million voters, including a GOTV universe of 588,000 Democratic voters who needed to turn out in this race to secure a victory for Chris Taylor. We sent millions of texts to engage these voters, however, these weren't just simple texts, what we deployed in Wisconsin was nothing short of a wonder weapon.
It is worth remembering that at no point in this race was victory assured.
On March 24th, 2 weeks out from E-Day, Marquette University released a troubling poll showing nearly 66% of voters undecided in this race, giving MAGA a clear pathway to victory.
These voters were undecided because they didn't have enough info about the candidates and the race. And that's where Defend our Courts came in.
In the past, it was nearly impossible for our small team of paid and volunteer staff to have real conversations with that many voters. That's why we partnered with progressive political AI startup Convos (formerly PubSent) to send multiple, massive waves of texts to our universe of voters to educate them and answer their questions about yesterday's elections.
---
| | [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BfqOdbWv32k8l7l_aycurijI4qv2CLNOM561Qf3JaQivWuG0H3S6kb3FXSY3gIHtu-vDCLqrm39vBP4LIkXpS6Ji3gfmFeEmTRCkSs9ydF-UBGBIXwDQ1u43LLQnutBGC0CDOb8EBgXW9yULjsRZuPj3wh0b1K5pypudKQB66w56fPhV-pggth7Dnb2hql_Ytzdgkt_WPXgoNf-VIQ6BeVNl8XWTZ14D0lZiiQyTrlFhdMEkuX1Jm54cTXwmm95TpN95fUIXjU4=&c=eWDwVCMlR7mhHSQRSNePweR2ZsDQPme2Jb6je4yvB2DMKu1ThEN4aA==&ch=S_6kO3dWNOPwI5jI_QRp6BYYfCnWPnj7eWqZ6sfmgQPPdLiFTl-T0Q==)
---
| | | | | In the past replies to our blast from voters would have gone mostly unanswered, however with our AI agent we were able to engage in thousands of meaningful conversations answering questions on the race, the candidates/their stances, and on voting (Many voters we talked to wrongly thought they might not be able to vote because of Trump's recent SAVE Act push).
These efforts made a decisive and direct impact on this race and none of it would have been possible without your support for Defend our Courts. So from the bottom of our hearts, and from the grateful people of Wisconsin: Thank you.
---

#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260409-1-expansion&t=1&akid=11373%2E3935704%2E9LPRYx)
---
Hi there, Jimmy Kimmel here.
I know you’re used to seeing me on your TV screen, but today I’m reaching out to you about an important topic close to my heart: _ending America’s gun violence crisis._
Gun violence isn’t always in the headlines, and it can be far too easy for us to go about our daily lives and forget that it’s happening each and every day. But for the families who now have empty seats at their dinner table — like the families who lost a child in Newtown, Parkland, or Uvalde — they can never, ever forget.
**[GIFFORDS is doing lifesaving work at the forefront of the gun safety movement, and I'm proud to be an ambassador for this incredible organization. Will you join me in supporting GIFFORDS PAC by making a contribution to support their work?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260409-1-expansion&t=2&akid=11373%2E3935704%2E9LPRYx)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260409-1-expansion&t=3&akid=11373%2E3935704%2E9LPRYx)**
Gun violence is a uniquely American epidemic. The leading cause of death for children in our nation is gun violence.
This is the only developed country in the world where this happens. We have to do something to change this.
Laws such as universal background checks, safe storage laws, and extreme risk protection orders would help ensure that guns can’t fall into the hands of people who shouldn’t have access to them. We call these laws common sense because that’s just what they are — common sense.
It is long past time for our representatives to do their job and truly represent the American people. The majority of Americans support commonsense gun safety legislation.
_**But instead, the Trump administration is focused on making guns even easier to buy and lining the pockets of his gun lobby allies._**
This is not a moment where we can sit back. We must be loud and use our collective voice to make a change. So please:
**[Will you make a commitment to ending our nation’s gun violence crisis by donating $3 to my friends at GIFFORDS PAC today? Your support is crucial.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260409-1-expansion&t=4&akid=11373%2E3935704%2E9LPRYx)

Bitcoin is one of the most important monetary innovations in a generation. It gives individuals a censorship-resistant alternative to government-controlled money, a fixed supply no central bank can dilute, and the ability to hold and transfer value without the permission of any intermediary. From a liberty standpoint, that is profoundly good.
So let me be clear: I support Bitcoin. What I oppose is the growing movement to have government buy and hold it as a "strategic reserve asset." Those of us who genuinely value both sound money and limited government should oppose it too.
The argument for state Bitcoin reserves sounds appealing. Proponents call it a hedge against inflation, a signal of financial innovation, a way to position states for a decentralized future. Some frame it as monetary sovereignty. But strip away the framing, and the question is simple: Should your state government be in the business of making investment decisions with taxpayer money?
The answer should be no--not because Bitcoin is too risky (private citizens are free to take risks with their own funds), but because government should not be a market actor at all. When a state buys Bitcoin hoping it will appreciate, that is not a reserve strategy. A reserve is about liquidity and stability. What proponents are describing is a portfolio decision--a bet on future price performance. Call it what it is: speculation with public funds.
Once lawmakers accept that logic, there is no limiting principle. If appreciation justifies buying Bitcoin, why not equities? Why not tech funds, real estate, or venture capital? Every asset class has a compelling long-term story. The moment government enters the investment business, the argument that it should invest only in Bitcoin becomes very hard to defend.
There is also the asymmetry of risk. In private markets, gains and losses fall on those who voluntarily took the position. In government, politicians take credit for gains and taxpayers absorb the losses--or the foregone alternatives. That is not market discipline. That is moral hazard financed by people who had no say in the matter.
Here is the deeper problem. A government actively seeking assets to purchase is a government that already assumes it has a legitimate claim to more money than it needs. If the state has surplus revenue, the proper response is not to build a portfolio. The proper response is to cut taxes, reduce spending, pay down obligations, and return resources to the private economy. State Bitcoin reserves become an excuse to avoid the harder reforms that actually matter.
Sound money matters because it limits government power. It disciplines politicians, restrains manipulation, and protects the public from the quiet theft of inflation. But adding Bitcoin to a state treasury does not restrain government--it expands its financial footprint, introduces new discretionary authority, and invites exactly the kind of political maneuvering that sound money is supposed to prevent.
Bitcoin was created as an alternative to government-managed money. It is a check on state power, not a new instrument of it. We should protect that distinction--and resist every effort, however well-intentioned, to blur it.

name: Jim Jordan
subject: No one should ever accuse you of being a Democrat
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Patriot!
| Patriot,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._

That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.

name: Eric Burlison for Congress
subject: Why Washington doesn’t want to audit itself.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Eric Burlison for Congress]()
body:
There’s a reason no one in Washington wanted to look at these numbers.

| | | | | [|
---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=c37a173579&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,

You would think that auditing empty government buildings to save taxpayer money would be the easiest vote in Congress. It’s not. Here’s the truth: there are people in Washington who benefit from the waste. Every empty building has a budget attached to it. Every budget has people who depend on it. Every agency has bureaucrats whose job it is to protect that budget — not to save you money. That’s the system. And it doesn’t give up ground easily. When I introduced this bill, I heard every excuse in the book: ❌ “The data is too complicated to assess.”❌ “We need more time to study the issue.”❌ “Private-sector involvement would be unprecedented.” Translation: they don’t want anyone looking too closely. That’s exactly why this bill matters. It requires transparency. It brings in outside experts who don’t have a bureaucratic interest in protecting the status quo. And it puts a 120-day deadline on delivering real answers. The House passed it. But now it goes to the Senate and that’s where bills like this go to die if no one’s paying attention. Taxpayers need to be paying attention. Standing firm,

Friend,
For months, two things haven't changed – I've been leading the GOP primary race to replace Mitch McConnell in the U.S. Senate, and my two opponents have been lighting money on fire attacking each other.
**We always knew as we got closer to the May 19th primary, they'd start to train their fire on me –** _**and now it's officially begun.**_
My opponent is trying, _desperately_ , to paint me as "weak" on law and order. **Over 100 Kentucky law enforcement leaders would disagree.**

#
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
Contact: Michael Biundo
[michael@ascent-strategic.com](mailto:michael@ascent-strategic.com)
Date: 09-APR-2026

**Lily Tang Williams Signs U.S. Term Limits Pledge
Releases 10-Point Good Government Plan**

Weare, NH: Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams today unveiled her comprehensive 10-Point Good Government Plan for New Hampshire’s 2nd District. The plan directly builds on Rep. Maggie Goodlander’s recent public statements calling for congressional term limits while exposing that Goodlander has still refused to sign the formal U.S. Term Limits pledge.

“Rep. Goodlander says she supports term limits, but she has refused to sign the U.S. Term Limits pledge that I signed years ago,” said Williams. “That pledge specifically commits members of Congress to three terms in the House and two terms in the Senate. Talk is cheap. New Hampshire deserves real commitment and a full plan to fix Washington’s broken system, not just headlines or vague rhetoric.”

Williams, who signed the U.S. Term Limits pledge as a candidate (and has pledged to cosponsor the exact amendment it calls for), positioned her 10-Point Good Government Plan as a bold, actionable blueprint to end the status quo of career politicians, secretive deals, endless spending crises, and self-dealing.

**Lily Tang Williams’ 10-Point Good Government Plan**
1. **Congressional Term Limits** — Cosponsor and vote for the U.S. Term Limits Amendment limiting U.S. House members to three terms and U.S. Senators to two terms, as required by the pledge Lily signed. This is a commitment Rep. Goodlander has talked about but still refuses to make.
2. **Single-Issue Bills Only** — Require every bill in Congress to address a single subject, ending the corrupt practice of massive omnibus bills stuffed with unrelated pork and special-interest giveaways.
3. **End Funding by Continuing Resolutions (CRs)** — Mandate on-time, full-year budgets to eliminate the annual cycle of government dysfunction, last-minute crises, and shutdown threats that hurt families and small businesses.
4. **Ban Stock Trading by Members of Congress** — Prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent children from trading individual stocks while in office. This is a reform long championed by Rep. Kat Cammack and supported across party lines to eliminate the appearance of insider trading.
5. **Balanced Budget Amendment** — Pass a constitutional amendment requiring the federal government to balance its budget, stopping the reckless accumulation of debt that will burden our children and grandchildren.
6. **Zero-Based Budgeting for Every Agency** — Force federal agencies to justify every single dollar of spending from scratch each year instead of automatically renewing last year’s bloated budgets.
7. **Ban All Earmarks and Pork-Barrel Spending** — Eliminate special-interest projects and political favors inserted into spending bills, ensuring taxpayer dollars serve the public interest, not politicians’ reelection campaigns.
8. **Strict Lobbying and Revolving-Door Reforms** — Impose lifetime bans on former members of Congress becoming lobbyists and enforce multi-year cooling-off periods for congressional staff to close the corrupt revolving door between Capitol Hill and K Street.
9. **Real-Time Transparency** — Require immediate public disclosure of all stock trades, campaign contributions, and lobbying contacts so voters can hold every member of Congress accountable 24/7.
10. **Independent Ethics Enforcement** — Create a truly non-partisan, independent congressional ethics commission with real investigative powers and the ability to impose swift penalties for violations.

“Rep. Goodlander has talked about term limits. I signed the pledge and I’m delivering a complete plan to fix what’s broken in Washington,” Williams concluded. “New Hampshire voters deserve more than one talking point. They deserve a full commitment to clean, accountable, and limited government. I’m ready to deliver it on Day One.”

Lily Tang Williams is the Republican candidate for New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District in 2026. A survivor of Mao’s China, a small-business owner, and a mother, she is running to protect freedom, secure the border, cut spending, and restore common sense in Washington. **Paid for by Lily4Congress Committee** ###

# **FBI arrests former Army employee for allegedly leaking classified special operations info to journalist Seth Harp**
The FBI arrested Courtney Williams, 40, a former Fort Bragg employee with top security clearance, for allegedly transmitting classified national defense information to a journalist, **[FBI Director Kash Patel announced Wednesday.](https://substack.com/redirect/87ea0236-eb42-40a8-9772-749aa4077dc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/87ea0236-eb42-40a8-9772-749aa4077dc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **What happened:** Authorities say from 2022-2025, Williams communicated with a journalist through 10+ hours of phone calls and 180 text messages, sharing "tactics, techniques and procedures" related to a special operations force. The journalist appears to be Seth Harp, author of "The Fort Bragg Cartel" and a POLITICO piece titled "My Life Became a Living Hell': One Woman's Career in Delta Force" focusing on Williams' experience.

* **Why it matters:** Patel said "let this serve as a message to any would-be leakers: we're working these cases, and we're making arrests. This FBI will not tolerate those who seek to betray our country," suggesting more arrests are "coming." The arrest follows President Trump threatening jail time for reporters who decline to identify sources in connection with a downed American aircraft leak.
* **The defense:** Harp says Williams "did nothing criminal," saying "Trump's unhinged DOJ will not even say what 'classified information' she allegedly leaked" and "the government is going after Courtney for the sole reason that she exposed sexual harassment and gender discrimination in the unit."

# **US Marine Daniel Montano, 21, fatally stabbed in North Carolina brawl**
Marine Lance Cpl. Daniel Montano, 21, **[died after being stabbed during a massive downtown Wilmington, North Carolina brawl](https://substack.com/redirect/7375dc15-6f2c-4923-87a0-1c0d827e7164?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** just after 2 a.m. Saturday, with disturbing video showing him hunched over a pool of blood pointing desperately to his neck as officers arrived and pepper-sprayed the fighting crowd. A bystander rushed over, took off his shirt, wrapped it around Montano's neck and applied pressure to stop the bleeding before both stabbing victims were rushed to Novant New Hanover Regional Medical Center with life-threatening injuries.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7375dc15-6f2c-4923-87a0-1c0d827e7164?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The 41-second viral clip appears to show officers failing to spring into action immediately to help the dying Marine, sparking heavy scrutiny of the Wilmington Police Department's response. Police Chief Ryan Zuidema defended officers' actions, saying "they have no idea who is who. They don't know who's a suspect, who's a victim. They just know there's people fighting in the street."
* **What 's next:** Police released photos of a "person of interest"--a man with dreadlocks wearing a denim jacket, pink t-shirt and white shoes with blue and red accents. The officers involved have been placed on paid administrative leave as the North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation takes over the case. Montano was assigned to 1st Battalion, 2nd Marines Regiment at Camp Lejeune from San Bernardino, California, with his sister writing he "was not only dedicated to his country, but also deeply loved by his family."

[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

While the world watches the fallout in Iran, Israel's assault on Lebanon
is intensifying – and the U.S. is planning to send another 20,000 bombs to
fuel it.

But Bernie is saying NOT ON MY WATCH – and needs ALL of us to stand with
him.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36398?source=email-20230409&t=1011&akid=10515%2E5885482%2ELAI9Aq ]Tweet by Bernie on 4/6/26: While the world focuses on the destruction
in Iran, we must not ignore what Israel is doing in Lebanon. 1,461 have
been killed. 4,430 have been injured. 1.2 million have been displaced.
Israel now occupies 14% of Lebanon. Enough is Enough. No more US military
aid to Israel.

Bernie filed a resolution to block this sale and will force a vote next
week – but he needs our movement behind him to get more members of
Congress on board.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36398?source=email-20230409&t=1012&akid=10515%2E5885482%2ELAI9Aq ]Will you urgently send a message to your members of Congress to tell
them: NO MORE BOMBS!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36398?source=email-20230409&t=1013&akid=10515%2E5885482%2ELAI9Aq ]ADD YOUR NAME

Just as Trump announced his "ceasefire" earlier this week, Israeli
airstrikes ripped through packed neighborhoods in Beirut without warning.
Dozens of lives lost in an instant. Hundreds wounded. These aren't
distant, impersonal numbers – these are families and entire communities
caught in a living hell.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36398?source=email-20230409&t=1014&akid=10515%2E5885482%2ELAI9Aq ]Headline: Israel pounds Lebanon with heaviest airstrikes of war as
Hezbollah pauses attacks

And what is Congress about to do? Turn the other way as Trump sends an
armory of 20,000 MORE U.S.-made bombs for Netanyahu's next wave of

When an Israeli missile demolishes a hospital or apartment complex, it is
OUR tax dollars funding the destruction. Each new shipment of bombs is a
blank check to Netanyahu. And unless Congress hears a tidal wave of
outrage *right now* the killing will continue with American support.

Enough.

| | Over the past few days, I’ve had several supporters reach out. “Have you seen this text from Tim?” I’ll spare you a click – it includes the following vivid imagery:
* _“I know your phone gets blown up like a possum in the middle of the road with all those political texts"_
* “ _Our House Majority is thinner than gas-station coffee_ ”
* _“President Trump is fighting like a junkyard dog”_ and
* _“He needs folks in Congress who won’t fold like a lawn chair the minute the cocktail circuit frowns at ‘em”_

Ironic, considering we know who folds like a lawn chair the minute he gets a phone call, a handshake, or a signed ball cap from the President. Underneath Tim’s characteristic folksy facade (or whatever they asked ChatGPT to spit out in an approximation of his voice), I hear something else: _**he’s worried.**_ He knows that President Trump's war, policies, and chaos are unpopular, but he refuses to stand up to him. **And he’s paying attention to this campaign. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | BREAKING: President Trump announces that he will be paying a "tariff dividend" of at least $2,000 per person. | Stimulus checks are officially back But why now? ✅ Recent market crashes ✅ Skyrocketing inflation ✅ A weak US dollar This isn’t just a “bonus” it’s a chance to shield your savings from what’s coming. Everywhere I go across Virginia, I hear from folks who are tired of the chaos and corruption being peddled by the Trump administration and enabled by my Republican colleagues. Gas prices are spiking because Trump chose to start a war in Iran. Health care is being gutted and premiums are skyrocketing, all so that congressional Republicans could hand out tax breaks to the wealthy. Hey folks,
**Don Lemon** and I jumped right into foreign policy, media spin, the cost of chaos--and didn't hold back. It's one of those conversations where you can feel the frustration building in real time.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] We break down the so-called "ceasefire" and why it's already falling apart--rockets still flying, nothing actually resolved.
* [**00:05:05**] The human cost hits hard: service members lost, families grieving--and what, exactly, did we gain?
* [**00:08:10**] How Trump's global strategy is isolating the U.S. and handing leverage to rivals like China.
* [**00:13:02**] "This is Trump's Katrina"--why this moment could define the collapse of his presidency.
* [**00:21:21**] The shifting goalposts: regime change, oil routes, uranium--none of it achieved, and Americans paying the price.

We talk about what actually happened here--beyond the headlines--and why it matters for all of us. This is about leadership, accountability, and the real-world consequences of political decisions that too often feel abstract until they're not. "**Fairfield First** " is becoming the banner for some truly unique policies, and this latest proposal involving Long Island Sound properties should concern every landowner in town.
[Sign the Petition](https://substack.com/redirect/85d0072c-f151-43cb-a598-3409cac31195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Right now, this may be framed as a narrow proposal affecting a limited area, but that is exactly how overreach often begins: one restriction, one neighborhood, one test case at a time. Today it is in-ground pools. Tomorrow it could be something else. Once government establishes the precedent that it can restrict ordinary homeowner improvements in one part of town without a clear code requirement or mandate, it becomes much easier to expand that logic elsewhere.
If you are a landowner in any part of Fairfield (or a neighboring town), this is your fight too.
[Sign the Petition](https://substack.com/redirect/85d0072c-f151-43cb-a598-3409cac31195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And if you are a homeowner in the affected area, you should be leading it.
This does not just impact a small group of waterfront residents. It raises a much bigger question about the future of property rights, homeowner autonomy, and coastal development in Fairfield. One has to wonder whether this is simply another example of natural overreach, or whether Fairfield is being used as a pilot program for broader shoreline policy that could eventually spread to other towns along the Connecticut coast.
If your property is in the affected area, this is a direct threat to your right to improve and enjoy your home. If your property is outside it, do not assume you are untouched. What is done to one group of property owners today can become the model used against others tomorrow.
Stand with your Fairfield neighbors. Defend your property rights. Reject this latest Fairfield First experiment before it becomes the new standard.

clean_body: When "One Small Rule" Becomes Everyone's Problem | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more The Goldstein Substack - A Father-Son Publication Dr. Goldstein is Running for Congress and his page can be found When "One Small Rule" Becomes Everyone's Problem | | and | Apr 9 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- "Fairfield First** " is becoming the banner for some truly unique policies, and this latest proposal involving Long Island Sound properties should concern every landowner in town. Right now, this may be framed as a narrow proposal affecting a limited area, but that is exactly how overreach often begins: one restriction, one neighborhood, one test case at a time. Today it is in-ground pools. Tomorrow it could be something else. Once government establishes the precedent that it can restrict ordinary homeowner improvements in one part of town without a clear code requirement or mandate, it becomes much easier to expand that logic elsewhere. If you are a landowner in any part of Fairfield (or a neighboring town), this is your fight too. And if you are a homeowner in the affected area, you should be leading it. This does not just impact a small group of waterfront residents. It raises a much bigger question about the future of property rights, homeowner autonomy, and coastal development in Fairfield. One has to wonder whether this is simply another example of natural overreach, or whether Fairfield is being used as a pilot program for broader shoreline policy that could eventually spread to other towns along the Connecticut coast. If your property is in the affected area, this is a direct threat to your right to improve and enjoy your home. If your property is outside it, do not assume you are untouched. What is done to one group of property owners today can become the model used against others tomorrow. Stand with your Fairfield neighbors. Defend your property rights. Reject this latest Fairfield First experiment before it becomes the new standard. | A guest post by| Consultant, Political Consultant, Campaign Manager, Construction Consultant and Corporate Attorney. body:
#

| | | | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
| Friends, it’s Mark Kelly.

Last week we sent three Americans and one Canadian back into space — to the moon. After everything our country has been through lately, with all of the division, all of the partisanship, that was something good.

It was a reminder of who we are as Americans. We try to do impossible things, we dream bigger than anyone in the world — and then we make it happen. The spirit of creativity, of innovation, of just going for it, that’s as much a part of who we are as anything else.

I’m proud to be an American, and I always will be. That doesn’t mean we’re perfect, but this country, our people, and the future we share are always going to be worth fighting for.

[**And if you are with me in that fight, please: Make a donation.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-apr26.E0ZGh8&refcode=em260409-1-90&t=1&akid=6409%2E6688874%2E8lT7OX)**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-apr26.E0ZGh8&refcode=em260409-1-90&t=2&akid=6409%2E6688874%2E8lT7OX)**
Thank you so much,

Mark Mark Kelly

body:

| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend, She was just a child. And the person who should have protected her was the one who first trafficked her. Her own mother. What began there didn’t stop. She was sold again and again. Passed between people who saw her as an object. Not a child.
Not a life.
Not someone worth protecting.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
As the years went on, the trauma only grew deeper. To survive, she turned to addiction - the only way to numb the pain. The only way to keep going. She even had children with one of the men who trafficked her. Another chain and reason it felt impossible to escape. For years, she lived in fear. No way out. Until one day, she reached a breaking point. With nothing but courage and fear in her heart, she ran, fleeing to a women’s shelter. No plan. No safety.
**Just hope that maybe someone would help her.** **And that is when everything began to change.** **Because someone did show up.** A partner of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** called House Parent Project. They didn’t turn her away. They didn’t question her worth. **They sat with her, they listened and believed her. And in that moment, light entered her story.**
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
They helped her take the next step.Then the next. And the next. They safely relocated her far from the people who had controlled her life. **For the first time in years, she could breathe.** She could begin to heal. But they didn’t stop there. They are still walking with her today, because her fight is not over. Her children are still connected to the man who trafficked her. And now, Sara is fighting to bring them to safety. Fighting to break the cycle for good. And she is not alone.
---
Friend, maybe this is your first time hearing about us. The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists for one reason: **_To stop the sale of God’s children._** We were born from the true story told in the film _Sound of Freedom,_ but this mission did not end when the credits rolled. It became a movement. Today, we work around the world to **prevent trafficking before it starts.** **We support partners that help rescue children in danger, support survivors on their long road to healing, and fight for laws that protect the innocent.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
**Because rescue is only the beginning.** Children need safety, healing and someone to walk with them on the long road ahead. **And that is what your support makes possible.** **Not just escape. But restoration. A future rebuilt.** You see, Friend, **Sound of Freedom Foundation’s** mission is simple: **_To stop the sale of God’s children._** We extend the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, shining a light on how real and widespread child trafficking is and what we must do to stop it.

**We believe in a future where this evil is gone.** **_A world where every child is safe and truly free._** Jesus said, _“Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me.”_ (Matthew 18:5) **Today you have the chance to be part of that welcome and****be part of that light.**
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Your gift today can help: **$25** — Support immediate outreach and response
**$50** — Provide critical care and stabilization
**$75** — Help relocate and protect a survivor
**$100** — Support ongoing care and legal advocacy **Because healing takes time.**
**Protection takes people.**
**And freedom takes courage from all of us.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
You can step in and help rewrite stories like Sara’s. Please give as generously as you can today. And please pray... **For Sara.**
**For her children.**
**And for every child still waiting for someone to show up.**
---
[ Protect Children And Restore Hope ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
**Because**** _God’s children are not for sale._** And together... we will not stop fighting for them. For God’s Children,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

name: Autism Health
subject: The AHS Conference is Almost Here!
body:
** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyPTtXfKYd8&mc_cid=284f32c67f&mc_eid=UNIQID

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The countdown is on. With only 2 weeks to go, we are excited to welcome you to the Autism Health Summit, taking place April 24–26, 2026 in San Diego at the Legacy Center Resort and Spa. This powerful three-day event brings together leading experts, practitioners, researchers, and families for a weekend of education, collaboration, and meaningful conversation around autism and neurological health.

We want to share an important update with our community. While the San Diego Regional Center will not be sponsoring tickets for this event due to unforeseen circumstances, we remain deeply committed to accessibility. We are offering scholarships for families (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/autismhealth.com%2Fscholarships%2F/b43o/uZXEAQ/AQ/09d8d57d-c464-4d14-8636-64893cd4133e/2/AxM5Y-0k3g?mc_cid=284f32c67f&mc_eid=UNIQID) with special needs who would like to attend.

As we approach the final weeks, we invite you to take advantage of our current offer. Use promo code Autism50 to receive $50 off your in-person ticket.

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=284f32c67f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Earn CME Credits At the AHS Conference!
We are proud to offer Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits for medical professionals attending the Autism Health Summit. Participants who purchase a Professional Ticket will be eligible to receive 10.5 CME credits, providing valuable, evidence-informed education while fulfilling continuing education requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for physicians and healthcare providers to gain deeper insights into emerging research, clinical applications, and integrative approaches to autism and neurological health.

Meet Our Headline Speakers & Sponsors!
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=284f32c67f&mc_eid=UNIQID

This year’s Summit features an outstanding lineup of headline speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Robert Malone, and Dr. Toby Rogers, along with many more respected voices in the field. Attendees will also hear from Ed Clay and his team at Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), who will share the latest updates and research surrounding their upcoming clinical trial for autism.

We are deeply grateful to our top Diamond, Platinum, and Gold Sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises, European Wellness, and Satellite Phone Store. Their commitment helps make this event possible and supports ongoing education and outreach within the autism community.

We also extend our sincere thanks to our Silver, Health, and Wellness Sponsors whose generosity and shared mission strengthen this work, including Functional Genomic Analysis, Neuro Needs, Microbiome Research Foundation, NutraMedix, Relax Saunas, MAHA Action, Best EMF Products, ARCC Center, Children's Health Defense, myMico Lab, Life Wave and Brain Tap, Daylight Computer Company, Weston A. Price Foundation, VibraTec Plates, Sun Power LED, Stalwart Law Group, DNA Academy, Function Medicine Georgia, Kadiant, Algonot, Informed Policy Advocates, Micronic Silver, SPELLERS, Spectrum Sciences LLC, The Wellness Blanket, Xlear, Vicar Venetia, Strategic Response Partners, Sabre Defense Team, Pur Health, LLC, Warrior Mom, Purium, C-Polar Technologies, OxyHealth, Solex AO Scan, Pulse PEMF, MAPS, PatchMD, CelWel, ReligenDX, Frequency+ Peptides, Mindset Kids, Mosaic Diagnostics, Leaps & Rebounds, Beautiful Minds Family Counseling, and Physicians for Informed Consent.

Join Us As We Walk for Autism!

This weekend, our community comes together in a powerful way to raise awareness, support families, and stand united for individuals with autism. We are honored to share two incredible events happening right here in San Diego County. Each one is an opportunity to make a difference, connect with others, and show your support.

Saturday, April 11 – Race for Autism
Join us at beautiful Balboa Park for the annual Race for Autism. This inspiring event brings together families, advocates, and professionals for a day filled with purpose, movement, and community connection. Whether you run, walk, or cheer from the sidelines, your presence helps shine a light on autism and supports vital programs.

Location: Balboa Park, San Diego, CA
Website: raceforautism.org (https://track.pstmrk.it/3/raceforautism.org/b43o/uZXEAQ/AQ/09d8d57d-c464-4d14-8636-64893cd4133e/4/GlPpFZVAdj?mc_cid=284f32c67f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Sunday, April 12 – Walk for Autism Awareness
Continue the momentum on Sunday at Vista Civic Center Park for the Walk for Autism Awareness. This heartfelt event is all about community, inclusion, and walking together for a brighter future. Bring your family, invite your friends, and be part of something meaningful.

Location: 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, CA
Website: vistawalkforautism.org (https://track.pstmrk.it/3/vistawalkforautism.org/b43o/uZXEAQ/AQ/09d8d57d-c464-4d14-8636-64893cd4133e/5/X4XgDdZSSY?mc_cid=284f32c67f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

These walks are more than just events... they are a reminder that no family walks this journey alone. Every step taken is a step toward awareness, understanding, and hope.

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). clean_body: The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here! April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California The countdown is on. With only 2 weeks to go, we are excited to welcome you to the Autism Health Summit, taking place April 24–26, 2026 in San Diego at the Legacy Center Resort and Spa. This powerful three-day event brings together leading experts, practitioners, researchers, and families for a weekend of education, collaboration, and meaningful conversation around autism and neurological health. We want to share an important update with our community. While the San Diego Regional Center will not be sponsoring tickets for this event due to unforeseen circumstances, we remain deeply committed to accessibility. We are offering scholarships for families () with special needs who would like to attend. As we approach the final weeks, we invite you to take advantage of our current offer. Use promo code Autism50 to receive $50 off your in-person ticket. We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community. REGISTER HERE () Earn CME Credits At the AHS Conference! We are proud to offer Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits for medical professionals attending the Autism Health Summit. Participants who purchase a Professional Ticket will be eligible to receive 10.5 CME credits, providing valuable, evidence-informed education while fulfilling continuing education requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for physicians and healthcare providers to gain deeper insights into emerging research, clinical applications, and integrative approaches to autism and neurological health. Meet Our Headline Speakers & Sponsors! This year’s Summit features an outstanding lineup of headline speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Robert Malone, and Dr. Toby Rogers, along with many more respected voices in the field. Attendees will also hear from Ed Clay and his team at Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), who will share the latest updates and research surrounding their upcoming clinical trial for autism. We are deeply grateful to our top Diamond, Platinum, and Gold Sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises, European Wellness, and Satellite Phone Store. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129122411/613363189/-1080350292?refcode=WUEFEP17_20260409_StopSAVEAct_ALL_v1s1&sourceid=1058272&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTRjYWZiYi0zNTM0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Jlx3z8sQm9kMjtkkcFfFRjhb10_rnJqb8s02dbC_q4o=) Peter,

In February, the U.S. House passed a new version of the SAVE Act — a dangerous, anti-democratic bill that would require American citizens to show documents like a birth certificate or passport just to register to vote. Now, the bill is stalled in the U.S. Senate, where Democratic pro-choice women are fighting hard to squash it. [_**The stakes couldn't be higher. Will you chip in today to fuel our fight to elect more women who support free and fair elections, Peter?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129122412/613363191/-1080350292?refcode=WUEFEP17_20260409_StopSAVEAct_ALL_v1s1&sourceid=1058272&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTRjYWZiYi0zNTM0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Jlx3z8sQm9kMjtkkcFfFRjhb10_rnJqb8s02dbC_q4o=) | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129122413/613363193/-1282862128?refcode=WUEFEP17_20260409_StopSAVEAct_ALL_v1s1&sourceid=1058272&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTRjYWZiYi0zNTM0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Jlx3z8sQm9kMjtkkcFfFRjhb10_rnJqb8s02dbC_q4o=)

Research shows that more than 21 million eligible U.S. citizens don't have easy access to their birth certificate or passport. That's **21 million Americans** who could be locked out of the ballot box — not because they're ineligible, but because they don't have the paperwork on hand.

And it gets worse. Married women who took their spouse's name, trans people who have updated their legal name, and anyone whose documents don't perfectly match would be forced to jump through even more hoops just to exercise their fundamental right to vote.

**This isn't voter protection. It's voter suppression.** It's exactly what Donald Trump and the Republican Party want ahead of the 2026 midterms, when they know their control of Congress is in deep danger.

clean_body: The SAVE Act’s fate rests in the Senate | = Peter, In February, the U.S. House passed a new version of the SAVE Act — a dangerous, anti-democratic bill that would require American citizens to show documents like a birth certificate or passport just to register to vote. Now, the bill is stalled in the U.S. Senate, where Democratic pro-choice women are fighting hard to squash it. = | = Research shows that more than 21 million eligible U.S. citizens don't have easy access to their birth certificate or passport. That's 21 million Americans who could be locked out of the ballot box — not because they're ineligible, but because they don't have the paperwork on hand. And it gets worse. Married women who took their spouse's name, trans people who have updated their legal name, and anyone whose documents don't perfectly match would be forced to jump through even more hoops just to exercise their fundamental right to vote. This isn't voter protection. It's voter suppression. It's exactly what Donald Trump and the Republican Party want ahead of the 2026 midterms, when they know their control of Congress is in deep danger. The House has done its damage. Now the fight moves to the Senate, and we have to stop it there. Electing pro-democracy women to the Senate is how we win this fight. Hey Peter, Today, the Democratic National Committee took up the question of whether our party should reject AIPAC's money and influence in our elections - and sadly, our leadership failed to meet the moment.
These groups have spent more than $230 million to support Donald Trump, and countless more to elect far-right republicans across the country. Yet the DNC continues to back them.
We should not be allowing a foreign government to have this kind of influence over our elections. Full stop. And that's not a radical position.
My opponent has spent 30 years in Congress building relationships with the very donors and lobbying networks that have made this possible. Her top career donor is a law firm founded and chaired by a former AIPAC board member.
I'm the only candidate in this race who has pledged to never take corporate PAC money and not a dime from AIPAC-aligned groups.
But here's where I really need your help: [AIPAC has entered primaries like ours before, and they've spent millions to take out candidates like me and won. Dear Peter,
If we’re serious about building a government that works for working people, we need leaders who have actually lived the struggle and are willing to fight to change it.
That’s why I’m proud to endorse Francesca Hong for Governor of Wisconsin.
Before I explain, will you rush a split contribution to support Fran and my campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rk-francesca-hong-fundraising-split?refcode=20260409]
DONATE >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rk-francesca-hong-fundraising-split?refcode=20260409]
Fran Hong isn’t a career politician. She’s a working mom. A restaurant worker. A chef.
She’s lived paycheck to paycheck. She’s had to make tough choices about childcare, groceries, and keeping the lights on.
And she’s never forgotten what that feels like.
In the Wisconsin State Assembly, Fran has become one of the most unapologetic voices for working families:
* Fighting for BadgerCare for All so healthcare is a right
* Leading efforts to abolish the tipped minimum wage

#### Good afternoon! Kevin Ford here.
#### Most people don’t realize this, but State Senators are some of the most important decision-makers in your daily life—and some of the least scrutinized.
#### They shape the policies that determine what you pay for utilities, how much groceries and everyday goods cost, and the fees tied to things like car registration and basic services.
#### So when families say everything feels more expensive—they’re right. These decisions are happening at the state level.
#### That’s why this race matters.
#### _**I’m running because families in Maryland are already carrying enough—and I’m committed to reducing that burden, not adding to it.**_
#### [**But here’s the reality: we’re just over 75 days out from Election Day, and right now we’re $4,235 short of our weekly goal.**](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69d7dd4bcd85476326ddfb19&u=https%3A%2F%2Fvotekevinford.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69d0fbd33fcb0262b8ae794d%26ss_email_id%3D69d7dd4bcd85476326ddfb19%26ss_campaign_name%3DMost%2Bpeople%2Bdon%25E2%2580%2599t%2Brealize%2Bthis%2Baffects%2Btheir%2Bbills%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-04-09T17%253A11%253A34Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69d0fbd33fcb0262b8ae794d&l=en-US&s=Q19Kkjd-N8ExV3HyBf-dFz67pnY%3D)
#### That gap will determine whether we expand our outreach and reach more families who are feeling this pressure every day, or scale back at the most critical moment of this campaign.
#### We don’t have time to lose ground.
#### [**If everyone reading this chipped in just $20, we’d close the gap today.**](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69d7dd4bcd85476326ddfb19&u=https%3A%2F%2Fvotekevinford.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69d0fbd33fcb0262b8ae794d%26ss_email_id%3D69d7dd4bcd85476326ddfb19%26ss_campaign_name%3DMost%2Bpeople%2Bdon%25E2%2580%2599t%2Brealize%2Bthis%2Baffects%2Btheir%2Bbills%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-04-09T17%253A11%253A34Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69d0fbd33fcb0262b8ae794d&l=en-US&s=Q19Kkjd-N8ExV3HyBf-dFz67pnY%3D)

| Hi Peter, Adam Spanberger here.

Earlier this year, my wife Abigail was inaugurated as Virginia’s 75th Governor. It was a historic moment not just for her, but for our entire Commonwealth. This milestone marked the beginning of a new chapter for Virginia – and for our family.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129123711/613367663/-1785190938?refcode=BLU_EM_UFVF_2026-04-09_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmU5OTk1OGUtMzczNC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NbdoYXZjfsSC5xT6d4Uo3hezU3Zyr0dBN_isoR6nwsQ=)
**As the First Gentleman of Virginia, I'm proud to support Abigail and advocate for the Commonwealth.** I’ve spent the last few weeks meeting with leaders who are working to strengthen our communities, create more opportunities for our kids, and make life easier for Virginians. I’ve also focused on supporting hands-on learning and partnering with organizations that are building a more inclusive and connected Virginia.

I'm committed to supporting students and ensuring our schools get the resources they need to succeed. And as an avid cyclist, I’m also working to promote Virginia’s trail systems for kids and families to unplug, spend more time outdoors, and be active together.

Abigail and I are committed to making Virginia a place where families can thrive, businesses will invest, and people can build a brighter future. But we can’t do this alone.

That’s why I’m reaching out.

We’re asking for your help to keep this momentum going. Through United for Virginia’s Future PAC, we’re continuing our work to elect leaders who will carry our shared vision forward and create a stronger, more prosperous Virginia for everyone.

clean_body: As the First Gentleman of Virginia, I'm proud to support Abigail and advocate for the Commonwealth. | = | Hi Peter, Adam Spanberger here. Earlier this year, my wife Abigail was inaugurated as Virginia’s 75th Governor. It was a historic moment not just for her, but for our entire Commonwealth. This milestone marked the beginning of a new chapter for Virginia – and for our family. = As the First Gentleman of Virginia, I'm proud to support Abigail and advocate for the Commonwealth. I’ve spent the last few weeks meeting with leaders who are working to strengthen our communities, create more opportunities for our kids, and make life easier for Virginians. I’ve also focused on supporting hands-on learning and partnering with organizations that are building a more inclusive and connected Virginia. I'm committed to supporting students and ensuring our schools get the resources they need to succeed. And as an avid cyclist, I’m also working to promote Virginia’s trail systems for kids and families to unplug, spend more time outdoors, and be active together. Abigail and I are committed to making Virginia a place where families can thrive, businesses will invest, and people can build a brighter future. But we can’t do this alone. That’s why I’m reaching out. We’re asking for your help to keep this momentum going. Through United for Virginia’s Future PAC, we’re continuing our work to elect leaders who will carry our shared vision forward and create a stronger, more prosperous Virginia for everyone. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for your support, Adam Spanberger | | = Paid for by United for Virginia's Future PAC United for Virginia's Future PAC P.O. name: James Talarico
subject: Loving and fighting don’t have to be at odds
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Talarico for Texas
body:
#
Peter —
We talk about building a movement that loves our neighbors — rejecting the politics of division to build a new politics rooted in love. I know some folks may wonder how this approach can win in this moment that demands more fighters in Washington.
But growing up I learned that loving and fighting don’t have to be at odds. So I want to tell you my family’s story and how it informs my approach to politics.
My mom is a preacher’s daughter from Laredo who left home at 19 and moved up to Austin, Texas. That’s where she met my birth father. He had a drinking problem that sometimes led to violence.
One night, when I was really little, he became abusive again, but that night my mother’s love rose to meet it. She packed all our stuff into her little Ford Escort and took me to the hotel where she worked. The manager let us stay in one of the rooms until we found a small apartment of our own in East Austin.
She showed me in a powerful way that love sometimes requires risking everything to fight for the people you love.
But that’s not where our family’s story ends. Our world changed when we met my adoptive dad: Mark Talarico.
Growing up, I always felt a little insecure that, unlike most kids, I wasn’t my dad’s “real son.” But mom always told me that my dad CHOSE to love me. And that’s the most powerful love of all.
Like parenthood, democracy is something most people take for granted as something that just happens to us. But neither is guaranteed. It requires hard work to nurture.
You have to choose to love it and to fight for it because it is a fragile gift. One that can be threatened by a demagogue in the Oval Office or rigged by billionaires and corporations.
That’s what our movement is doing. We are fighting for our democracy and to transform our politics because we love our neighbors.

Beyond its 171 million books (+1 with '[Songs About the Heartland](https://substack.com/redirect/0b7d345e-98bf-415b-a30e-b9f4293ef420?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)' added) and manuscripts, the Library of Congress safeguards an array of bizarre artifacts that reveal the quirky side of American history. Curators at the nation's oldest federal cultural institution maintain everything from centuries-old cake to locks of famous Americans' hair, creating a collection that surprises even the most seasoned researchers.

Among the most unusual holdings is a slice of wedding cake from the 1863 marriage of General Tom Thumb (Charles Stratton) and Lavinia Warren, which once impressed President Abraham Lincoln at their White House reception. The confection arrived at the library in the 1950s as part of the papers of actress Minnie Maddern Fiske and her husband, Harrison Grey Fiske.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Igx3FeuEKSsWNg2fAoSlcbaqin1CxGE9d6OJ6u4eUyA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193708640)
Perhaps more unsettling to modern sensibilities is the library's extensive collection of human hair. Curators have preserved locks from numerous historical figures, including Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Walt Whitman, and even composer Ludwig van Beethoven. These personal keepsakes were commonly exchanged as tokens of affection in earlier centuries.

The library also maintains a small but historically significant collection of Sigmund Freud's cocaine, which the famed psychoanalyst used before the substance's harmful properties were widely understood. The Controlled Substances Act now prevents the library from adding similar items to its collection.

In testament to its commitment to preserving modern culture, the Library of Congress has begun archiving social media posts. Rather than just documenting political discourse, curators have recognized the historical value of everyday digital communications that future researchers might find invaluable for understanding 21st-century life.

"We no longer see these items as curiosities," explained one librarian, "but as artifacts that tell a more complete story of our nation's cultural heritage--from the personal keepsakes of famous figures to the digital breadcrumbs of ordinary Americans."

The collection demonstrates how the Library of Congress has evolved beyond traditional library materials to embrace the strange and unexpected elements that make up the tapestry of American history.

For Fiscal Year 2024, the Library of Congress operates with a budget of $843.7 million. This represents an increase of $15.2 million from the previous year's funding level. The Library had originally requested $895.2 million for FY2024, but Congress approved approximately $51.5 million less than that request.

Looking ahead, the Library has requested $898 million for Fiscal Year 2025, which would represent a 5% increase from the FY2024 enacted budget. This funding supports the Library's core operations including acquisition and preservation of materials, programming, technological development, copyright administration, and services to Congress and the public.

The Library's budget supports its vast collection including books, recordings, photographs, maps, and manuscripts, as well as the unusual artifacts, such as historic wedding cake and locks of hair to now include your tweets. The funding also enables the Library to serve Congress through the Congressional Research Service and the Copyright Office, while providing resources to millions of visitors and researchers annually.

| Peter,

Before I was in Congress I was the Hempstead Town Supervisor running the largest township in the United States.

I managed a nearly $500 million budget, cut wasteful spending, took on corruption and actually lowered taxes for residents after years of hikes in a town that hadn't elected a Democrat in over a century. And I did it because I believe the government should work for the people paying for it, not the people running it.

That’s why the waste and corruption of the Trump administration make me so angry. Under Trump’s leadership, we've seen the government become a tool for the wealthy and powerful, leaving everyday Americans behind.

This is not what the government is supposed to be and it's not why I went into public service.

Holding this seat is how we fight back. Democrats need to take back the House majority to have any real check on this administration and defending this seat is crucial to making it happen. A Democratic majority means oversight, accountability and a Congress that actually stands up to Trump instead of rubber-stamping everything he does.

[_**But I need your help to continue this fight. We’re in one of the most competitive districts in the country, and the stakes are higher than ever. Every contribution makes a difference. Something unsettling is happening in the upper reaches of America's most sensitive scientific and technological sectors. Over the past couple of years, particularly intensifying from mid-2025 into early 2026, at least **[nine individuals with deep ties to cutting-edge research](https://substack.com/redirect/8d44a3a2-b3a9-4ceb-bd31-4652f16dabe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in aerospace, propulsion, nuclear fusion, materials science, and space technologies have either died under murky circumstances or simply vanished without a trace.
These aren't random lab technicians or junior analysts. Many worked at institutions like NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), Los Alamos National Laboratory, MIT's Plasma Science and Fusion Center, and the Air Force Research Laboratory--places where knowledge of America's most guarded secrets in missiles, rockets, satellite tracking, and advanced energy systems resides.

**When consumers give up, the markets fall fast and hard. 401(k) 's are in for a rough ride. **When it comes to America's financial health, economists point to a specific number in the "Expectations Index" that cannot be ignored.
**When the Expectations Index is below 80,[it's a major warning sign that a recession is near.](https://substack.com/redirect/d1e6367e-7aaf-4ce1-a5c3-a25de1c3d4d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) In January, the Expectations Index rating fell to 65.**
This isn't just a dip, it is a declaration. Our economy relies on a strong job market and confident consumers buying goods. In 2026, America's working class is taking extreme caution with non-essential spending.
2026 polling data from the HR Executive reports of "a worried and distracted workforce, whose concerns have them in "survival mode."
**This "crisis of confidence" may have the biggest impact on those near retirement. It indicates deep, structural stress in the framework holding up your 401(k)'s and IRA's.**
Most 401(k)s and IRAs are designed for "fair weather." They thrive when the economy is booming. They are not built to withstand the pressure of "a 12-year low in consumer confidence."
**Gold is the "Foul Weather" Fund. When expectations drop and paper markets begin to crumble, the rich often turn to physical gold and silver to preserve their wealth.**
One wealth saving move involves an IRS loophole that allows a tax-free, penalty-free transfer of funds from a 401(k), IRA, or pension, into physical gold and silver.
