* * *
_**by Lawrence Winnerman, Blue Amp Media COO**_
If you sat down with the most brilliant strategic minds in Moscow, Beijing, and Tehran--gave them unlimited funding, decades of planning, and a mandate to dismantle American global leadership from the inside--they could not have designed a more effective instrument of destruction than Donald Trump.
That is not hyperbole. It is an observation so plainly supported by the evidence that the only real question left is whether we are watching incompetence so total it mimics sabotage, or sabotage so brazen it hides behind incompetence.
Let's talk about what just happened. Because what just happened should end careers, end presidencies, and--if we still had a functioning political culture--end the fantasy that this man has any business making decisions that affect the lives of 330 million Americans, let alone the stability of the global order.
## No Plan. No Map. No Clue.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/10e44324-2449-45f4-aded-2e5e34ccd838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Six weeks ago, Donald Trump launched a full-scale war against Iran--with Israel as a co-belligerent, against a nation of 92 million people that sits on one side of the most strategically significant chokepoint on the planet. He did this with no defined objectives, no exit strategy, and no apparent understanding of what would happen next.
Anyone with a passing familiarity with Middle Eastern geopolitics--anyone who has glanced at a map--knows that Iran can shut the Strait of Hormuz. This is the single most discussed vulnerability in global energy security, written about in thousands of papers, war-gamed in hundreds of Pentagon exercises, understood by every defense analyst who has drawn a paycheck in the last forty years.
Nearly one-fifth of the world's oil and natural gas transits through that strait. When Iran choked it off, gasoline prices skyrocketed worldwide. The global economy shuddered. And Trump--the man who launched the war that made this entirely predictable--stood at a podium acting as though the consequences were someone else's fault.
He had no plan for this. None. He walked into the most foreseeable strategic trap in modern military history and then expressed surprise when the trap closed.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.TJi702fYbpQIOn2HQi3R25rAQTili2B0opfNKz2D67U?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193708660)
## "A Whole Civilization Will Die Tonight"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/10e44324-2449-45f4-aded-2e5e34ccd838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And then came the post.
On the morning of April 7, as the world waited to see whether the United States would escalate its assault on Iranian civilian infrastructure--power plants, bridges, the systems that keep a nation of 92 million people alive--Trump wrote on Truth Social: _" A whole civilization will die tonight, never to be brought back again."_
Read that again. Slowly.
There is only one way to kill a civilization so that it is "never brought back again." That is annihilation. That is the language of nuclear weapons. That is the rhetorical territory of extinction--a place no American president has ever gone publicly, not during the Cuban Missile Crisis, not during the Cold War, not during any moment when rational leaders understood that the power of these weapons lies in their _restraint_ , not in the threat of their use against civilian populations.
Trump went there. He said it out loud, on social media, like a man threatening a neighbor's dog.
The implications are staggering and irreversible. Every nation on earth that has been weighing whether to pursue nuclear weapons just received the clearest possible signal: the United States will threaten civilizational extinction on a Tuesday afternoon between Truth Social posts. The nonproliferation regime that American diplomats spent seventy years constructing--the careful architecture of treaties, assurances, and strategic ambiguity that kept the nuclear club small--was undermined more by that single post than by anything any adversary has ever done.
This is a genie that does not go back in the bottle. You cannot un-say that. You cannot walk it back with a ceasefire negotiated by _Pakistan_ --a sentence that itself should make every American pause and consider how far we have fallen.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=193708660&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkzNzA4NjYwLCJpYXQiOjE3NzU3Njg4MDAsImV4cCI6MTc3ODM2MDgwMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.iJoQ3xPshl5QXvh_vdECzElNw1rcxlL0bRug5wTzHaQ)
## The Desperation Deal
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/10e44324-2449-45f4-aded-2e5e34ccd838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Because that is exactly what happened. Trump made a threat so monstrous, so disconnected from any achievable strategic objective, that he was left with only two options: follow through on civilizational annihilation, or back down.
He backed down. Of course TACO Trump backed down. But he backed down badly.
The ceasefire--announced ninety minutes before Trump's own self-imposed deadline--was brokered by Pakistan. The United States of America, the nation that has styled itself as the indispensable power, the architect of the international order, needed Pakistan's prime minister to call a timeout because our president had talked himself into a corner from which there was no dignified exit.
And the terms? Iran agreed to allow passage through the Strait of Hormuz--but only through coordination with its armed forces. Iran is now effectively asserting sovereign toll authority over the most important waterway in global commerce. Iranian state news has reported that Tehran and Oman would charge transit tolls for vessels passing through the strait. The Iranian Parliament speaker said publicly that the Strait of Hormuz will not return to its pre-war status.
Let that sink in. Before Trump's war, ships transited the Strait of Hormuz freely. Now Iran controls the passage and is monetizing it. This is not a return to the status quo. This is a net strategic gain for Iran--extracted from a war that Trump started.
As David Shuster noted yesterday, some back of the envelope math shows this arrangement adding about $50 billion to Iran's GDP of $350 billion annually. That's nearly 15% GDP growth!
Other nations must be asking "How can we get a deal that good?!"
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=193708660&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkzNzA4NjYwLCJpYXQiOjE3NzU3Njg4MDAsImV4cCI6MTc3ODM2MDgwMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.iJoQ3xPshl5QXvh_vdECzElNw1rcxlL0bRug5wTzHaQ&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
## Israel Says No
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/10e44324-2449-45f4-aded-2e5e34ccd838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It gets worse.
Within hours of the ceasefire announcement, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared that the truce does not include Lebanon. Pakistan's mediator had explicitly stated it did. Iran's position was that the agreement covered all fronts. Trump and Netanyahu simply overruled reality.
Israel then launched its largest single-day attack of the entire war--more than one hundred strikes across Lebanon, killing at least 254 people and wounding more than 1,160, hitting residential buildings, mosques, medical centers, and cemeteries. Iran immediately accused Israel of violating the truce and threatened to withdraw from the agreement and shut the strait again.
So the ceasefire that Trump hailed as a "big day for world peace"--the deal he was forced into by his own reckless rhetoric--was functionally undermined by his closest ally within hours. And the United States either could not or would not stop it.
Vice President Vance, dispatched to explain the debacle, called it a "legitimate misunderstanding" and said it would be "dumb" for Iran to walk away over Lebanon. This is the diplomatic posture of the most powerful nation on earth: _shrug emoji_.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.TJi702fYbpQIOn2HQi3R25rAQTili2B0opfNKz2D67U?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193708660)
## What No Enemy Could Achieve
Now zoom out. Consider what Trump has accomplished in six weeks:
He launched an unprovoked war that legal experts have described as a violation of international law. He threatened to extinguish a civilization. He destabilized global energy markets so severely that oil prices remain above pre-war levels even with a ceasefire in place. He handed Iran a credible claim to toll authority over the Strait of Hormuz--a claim that did not exist before this war. He alienated European allies, who issued a joint statement demanding Lebanon's inclusion in the ceasefire over the explicit objections of the United States and Israel. He demonstrated that the United States cannot control its own ally in the middle of a ceasefire it brokered. He needed Pakistan to save him from his own deadline. And he floated the idea of a "joint venture" with Iran to patrol the strait--a proposal so incoherent it would be funny if it weren't terrifying.
The Soviet Union spent forty years and trillions of rubles trying to fracture Western alliances, undermine American credibility, and establish leverage over global energy flows. They failed. China has spent decades building alternative institutions and trade networks designed to reduce American influence. They have made progress, but the architecture of American-led order remained largely intact.
Donald Trump has done more to achieve these objectives--in six weeks--than either of those powers managed in generations.
Russia could not split the U.S. from its European allies on a matter of war and peace. Trump just did. China could not establish a rival power's toll authority over the world's most critical energy chokepoint. Trump just created the conditions for it. No adversary could get the United States to publicly threaten nuclear annihilation against a non-nuclear state on social media, shattering the credibility of the nonproliferation regime. Trump did it between breakfast and lunch.
If you were constructing a human being in a lab--engineering a single figure whose instincts, ignorance, and ego would combine to pull down the pillars of American power--you could not improve on this design.

Hi Peter,
OLCV's Annual Celebration for the Environment is right around the corner on April 24th and we're giving away a once-in-a-lifetime "Choose Your Own Adventure" travel package! For just $100, you can enter to win an unforgettable vacation while supporting OLCV’s work to protect Oregon’s environment. [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
We’re excited to spotlight one of the most thrilling packages you can choose if you’re our lucky winner. If you’ve been dreaming of fresh powder, mountain views, and the perfect winter escape, this one's for you!
Jackson Hole Horizons
Experience the magic of the Tetons with an alpine getaway that blends world-class skiing, wildlife, and cozy mountain charm. This three-night package for two includes:
* Full-day lift tickets for two at one of Jackson Hole’s renowned mountain resorts, home to powdery slopes, sweeping vistas, and terrain for every skill level
* Your choice of an iconic winter experience: * A horse-drawn Elk Refuge Sleigh Ride, where you’ll glide through snowy landscapes and see the majestic elk herd up close
* A Distillery Tour at Jackson Hole Still Works, with tastings of handcrafted spirits in a rustic, welcoming setting

* A 3-night stay at either The Lodge or The Rockwell Inn: mountain retreats with fireplaces, modern comfort, and views that make you want to stay wrapped in a blanket forever
It’s the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation, set in one of the most stunning winter destinations in the country.
Buy your raffle ticket [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
If skiing isn’t your thing, the raffle winner can also choose from two other incredible vacations :
🌴 Coastal Cabo Oceanfront Escape
✨ Grand Canyon Luxury Sky Dome Glamping
Every raffle ticket purchased fuels OLCV’s work to protect Oregon’s climate, public lands, clean water, and wildlife. You get a chance at the trip of a lifetime, and Oregon gets a win too.
Tickets are $100 and limited. Get yours now! [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
Thank you for supporting OLCV, and good luck!

Quietly and consistently.

Friend, Seth has been one of the strongest voices in Congress on women's health, and March was no exception. More mothers die in the U.S. than in nearly every other developed nation, and Black women are dying at nearly three times the rate. Think about that statistic—and the enormity of its consequences. Despite this, the Trump administration is actively trying to gut family planning funding that millions of women depend on. And to top it all off, equal rights still aren't written into the Constitution. Seth is fighting on all of it: he co-sponsored the Momnibus Act to end the maternal health crisis in the U.S. and eliminate racial disparities. He's pushing back on RFK Jr. for sitting on Title X funding, and he's working to codify the ERA. Seth isn't going to stop fighting when he gets to the Senate. He's going to go harder — on reproductive freedom, on maternal care, on making sure women's health isn't treated as a negotiable line item every time there's a budget fight. As the proud father of two beautiful girls, this is personal for Seth. Massachusetts deserves a senator who treats this like the priority it is every single day, not just when it's convenient. Peter

Right now, millions of people around the world are watching Artemis II and feeling something we don’t get enough of these days: hope.

It’s a reminder of what this country is capable of when we come together around a shared mission – not division, not chaos, not endless conflict – but purpose.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129134996/613405858/-635348808?refcode=em-4.9.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODJkNTE3ZS01NjM0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wQevorNgFYvzutrPS57VGV91m1jUnKv_jUHstyWXZr4=&emci=123bfcd5-5334-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=082d517e-5634-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=36198509)
_I had the privilege of meeting the Artemis II crew in Washington earlier this year._
Before I had the honor of representing CA-27 in Congress, I served as NASA Chief of Staff under President Obama. I saw up close what it takes to turn bold ideas into reality.

At NASA, we didn’t ask whether something was easy. We asked whether it was worth doing.

Because that’s who we are at our best.

We will explore. We will build.

**But at the very moment we’re proving what’s possible, Trump is proposing devastating cuts to NASA – slashing nearly half of its science budget.**

That’s not just short-sighted. It’s a retreat from leadership, from innovation, and from the spirit that drives us forward.

We can’t let that happen.

Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand?
The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill.
But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction.
So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026.
That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT!
That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are...
- Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024- Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year- Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course- Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did- Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris
They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth.
It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too.
That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer.
And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels.
The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot.

Republican spending, polling, and a whole bunch of other things, but
today, I wanted to send you a different kind of email.

the campaign trail, meeting voters, holding events, and talking to

Learn more about the Our Copa initiative, grab resources, and learn how you can get more involved. | | | Peter, The 2026 FIFA World Cup will be the biggest sporting event ever held in North America. We’re here to make sure this moment belongs **to the people** — the fans, the families, and the communities who make the game beautiful. body:
From Brownsville to Amarillo to El Paso to Houston.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
I have had a very busy year on the road so far, and I would not trade it for anything.
I have been traveling all across Texas, meeting people where they are, listening to what’s on their minds, and sharing why I believe our state deserves better.
I also cleared the first big hurdle and became the Democratic nominee for Governor. Now we are headed straight toward November, where we’re going to take on Greg Abbott and win.
From Brownsville to Amarillo, El Paso to Houston, I am working to earn every vote by showing up and putting in the work in every corner of our state. But I can’t do it alone.
[**If you can, will you chip in $5 right now to help keep me on the road and keep building the movement it will take to beat Greg Abbott?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260409_1_film.Xn2P3A&refcode=em20260409-891&amount=5&t=1&akid=891%2E299639%2EAiVpo7)
Here are a few (very cool) pictures in film that my team took from the trail:
[****](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260409_1_film.Xn2P3A&refcode=em20260409-891&amount=5&t=2&akid=891%2E299639%2EAiVpo7)

| Peter,

A new poll confirms what families across Montgomery County already know:

_**Residents do not support broad-based tax increases.**_ But that is exactly what is being proposed.

The current budget includes a **property tax rate increase** , an **income tax increase** , and a range of **new fees on residents and local businesses**.

The proposal is asking working families to pay more taxes when they’re struggling with higher grocery, gas, and utility costs, while simultaneously INCREASING the county’s fiscal challenges rather than solving them.

**That is crazy.**

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
Breaking: Major news from my office —
We just dismantled a massive hospice fraud operation in Los Angeles County that defrauded Medi-Cal of $267 million.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
That’s more than a quarter of a billion dollars in taxpayer funds — money paid for by California taxpayers to provide care for Californians who are sick and vulnerable.
Our investigation found that instead of supporting Californians in need, those funds were siphoned off through a coordinated scheme built on stolen identities, sham hospice companies, and billing for care that never existed. Not one legitimate hospice service was ever provided.
We’ve already arrested five individuals, executed search warrants across Southern California, and filed charges against 21 suspects. And we’re going to see this case through.
You may be hearing healthcare fraud from Donald Trump a lot these days — it’s his shiny new political talking point. But he’s late to the party. The California Department of Justice has been investigating and prosecuting Medi-Cal fraud since 1979 — long before Donald Trump decided to start talking about it.
This isn’t a political game for us. It’s about protecting taxpayer dollars and protecting the programs people rely on.
When fraud like this happens, it drains critical resources from a system millions of Californians depend on. It undermines trust and threatens care for the people who need it most.
It’s unacceptable, and we won’t stand by and let anyone get away with it.
If you believe in this work, I’m asking for your support. Can you make a contribution today to help keep it going? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]

Rob

Jon Fetherston's live reporting from a Portland bus shelter highlights conditions that regular riders say have become routine, from visible drug use to safety concerns for vulnerable residents. Portland resident, Ryan Tinsman joins the livestream to point to a pattern of short-term fixes that fail to address underlying issues at transit stops across the city. "They'll do something for a week or two and then it goes away," Tinsman explains, suggesting that enforcement and cleanup efforts often fade as quickly as they appear.

Boysko Bulletin: Governor Spanberger Vetoed the Casino Legislation!
Dear Peter,
April 9, 2026
MEDIA ADVISORY - FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Senator Boysko’s Statement Regarding the Veto of the Casino Legislation
The casino bill has met its end today. I’m deeply grateful that Governor Spanberger listened to the residents in Fairfax County and has vetoed SB 756 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20261/SB756] . Our community has been united in opposition of this casino legislation for years, spending countless hours organizing. Northern Fairfax County and the Tyson’s region have been carefully planned with community engagement and through that careful planning is a major economic engine for the entire Commonwealth.
As I, and all of the other elected officials representing Northern Fairfax, have stressed, it would be a mistake to put a casino that is unwanted here. The people spoke and Governor Spanberger listened.
Thanks to everyone who has been involved over the past several years. Your voice matters!
###
Kindest regards,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/102624/images/2024%20February%20Images/electronic%20signature.png]

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | Warren Buffett is sitting on $380 billion in cash. name: AOC
subject: The brutal reality
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We are all that we have.
#
I was treated horribly by my own party. I just was.
I was told that I was an enemy of my party.
That I was going to be the reason why the Right won.
That the entire future of the country was in balance and that _I_ was the reason why we would lose.
What was hurtful was that they were telling me this because of what I believed.
I was being told this because of my commitment to trans rights, Medicare for All — which is seen as radical communist propaganda — and workers' rights.
In the Democratic Party we have a broad coalition, and so some of the most conservative members of the Party.... it can be hard.
But **the brutal reality is that we are all that we have**. We will not survive apart.
I know. I’ve been there. It feels very difficult and challenging when the people who are diminishing you are the ones that you need.
We have to learn how to hold conflict, and hold together in conflict.
Our main project now is to **unite the working class in this country against a fascist agenda**. Period.

body:
https://alexkelloff.com/ [https://alexkelloff.com/]A Letter from Alex
My Dad always taught me to do well, so that I could do good. And after Donald Trump was reelected in November 2024, I knew it was time to step back from a successful business career and try to “do good.” I am running because I care about Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District. My family roots in the District go back over 130 years, when my ancestors immigrated to Trinidad, CO. And because I care, I began my campaign almost a year ago. In this massive district of 27 counties, there are no shortcuts. You have to put in the time, meet voters where they are at and earn every single vote. That’s what we have been doing since we started. Over 130 events, 10,000+ miles traveled meeting thousands of constituents. We don’t show up to work late, we start early!
I have listened to, and learned from, our constituents, and solemnly promise that if I am elected I will fight every day to:
* Create good jobs so that we can all live where we work and continue to keep the American Dream alive and well for our families.
* I will immediately fight for healthcare for all, ensure that we double down on critical investments in housing, education, veterans benefits, child care, transportation and other critical infrastructure.
* I will protect our public lands and ensure that OUR WATER stays in OUR COMMUNITIES.
* I will ensure that we uphold the rule of law: no more unlawful ICE actions, no more unconstitutional executive orders and no more illegal tariffs which are just a tax on the American people.
* And I will be the first in line to ensure that Congress gets back to fulfilling its constitutional obligation as a co-equal branch of government and stopping the illegal wars of choice this administration has started.
I know a lot of my priorities sound obvious and in many ways they are. But the differences that I bring are fresh ideas on how to actually implement these to ensure WE GET WINS from day 1 and long after. This includes revising the tax code so that everyone pays their fair share, updating our regulatory regimes so it’s easier to start and grow small businesses, leveraging existing laws and legislating for new ones to break monopoly practices, and ensuring the independence of our financial system and financial regulators to maintain public trust and stability. This is a fight and I am fighting every day for this District.
And it includes leadership - leading from the front, which is what I have done my whole career. This is how we can get back on track as a country to flip this seat, take back Congress and take back OUR DEMOCRACY .
— Alex
March Recap:
March was a packed month for our campaign, with Alex continuing to crisscross Colorado’s 3rd District and build real momentum on the ground. As we head toward the summer, our focus remains the same: show up, put in the work, and earn every vote.
This month also marked major milestones in the campaign calendar. Across county caucuses and assemblies throughout the District, we saw an incredible show of support from grassroots activists and delegates. In the 3 largest counties, our campaign earned 2.5 times the number of delegates as our opponent, proof that the work we’ve been putting in across all 27 counties is paying off. We carried that momentum into the district assembly, where we claimed the top spot on the primary ballot.
From Pueblo to Grand Junction, Alamosa to Glenwood Springs, and stops in Rocky Ford, La Junta, Trinidad, Fowler, Delta, Gunnison, Cedaredge, Walsenburg, Monte Vista, Ouray, San Luis, Durango, Pagosa Springs, and beyond - we’ve continued to meet people where they are, hear their stories, and share our vision for the future of Colorado’s 3rd District. We learned about the CRHDC housing project that helps make single family homes more attainable and the need for childcare funding in the San Luis Valley. We also learned about the Boys and Girls Club of Pueblo County and the importance of funding programs like this, especially in areas where there is a 4-day school week.

Alex has never been someone who backs down from a challenge. Whether it was supporting the United States Marine Corps and earning a Certificate of Commendation as a civilian, building businesses from the ground up, or now taking on one of the most competitive races in the country - he’s always stepped up when it matters. That same grit and determination is exactly what he’s bringing to this campaign and what he’ll bring to Congress - fighting every day for the people of Colorado’s 3rd District, just like he has for almost a year on the campaign trail.
This is what building a winning campaign looks like.
Holding Hurd Accountable
Trump Re-endorses Hurd: In a stunning political reversal, Donald Trump has reinstated his endorsement of Representative Jeff Hurd. This comes just one month after Trump publicly yanked his support, labeling Hurd a "RINO" for bucking the administration on a tariff vote. What changed? Reports indicate that an army of lobbyists and Republican insiders descended on Mar-a-Lago, warning that a primary challenge could cost them the seat. To clear the path, Trump even offered Hurd’s primary challenger, Hope Scheppelman, a job in his administration in exchange for her dropping out. While Hurd calls this "unity," it is clear he answers to special interests and party bosses, not the people of Colorado.
Hurd Wants to Defend the Indefensible: Jeff Hurd regularly takes to social media to tout various achievements and positive highlights he claims are tucked inside the Big Ugly Bill. However, he conveniently leaves out the devastating impact this legislation has on the people of our district. Despite his attempts to spin the bill as a win, the reality is that it targets the very programs our rural communities rely on most. Nonpartisan analysis shows the bill sets the stage for massive cuts to Medicaid, which would strip healthcare access from seniors and families across CO-3. While Hurd focuses on his carefully curated list of talking points, he is ignoring the fact that his vote actively threatens the survival of our rural hospitals and the health of our neighbors.
The SAVE Act: A Direct Attack on Your Right to Vote: Jeff Hurd is doubling down on his support for the SAVE Act, a bill that creates unnecessary and dangerous hurdles for legal citizens who want to cast their votes. By requiring documentary proof of citizenship like a passport or a birth certificate just to register, this law ignores the reality that many Americans do not have these documents readily available. Even more concerning is the strict requirement for names to match exactly across all documents. This creates a massive risk for married women whose names may have changed over time. If a woman's birth certificate does not perfectly match her current legal ID, she could be barred from the ballot box entirely. Hurd is essentially voting to treat Colorado voters like suspects and placing bureaucratic red tape between you and your most fundamental right as an American.
What’s Coming Soon
The next few weeks are packed with opportunities to connect with folks across the district. We are continuing to add new events across the district to learn and listen. Stay tuned for specific times and locations - and be sure to check our emails and social media accounts as new events are added. We look forward to seeing you on the trail!
* April 12 - Beaver Creek Fundraiser
* April 18 - Huerfano County Mother Jones Dinner
* April 18 - Durango Fundraiser
* April 25 - Grand Junction Fundraiser
* May 2 - Mayfest in Parachute
You’ll also be hearing Alex’s voice on the airwaves. Throughout March and April, Alex joined several podcasts and radio shows to talk about the race and the issues that matter most to Southern and Western Colorado. Alex was on the Gondolacast [https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-gondolacast-037-alex-kelloff-for-co/id1495925133?i=1000748856900] , Kate for the People [https://substack.com/home/post/p-185548997] , the Bill & Jeff [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GRuQXI5eT6U] radio show, the San Luis Valley Voices [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oyqe3rqOH7o&t=1253s] podcast, the Gaze at the Parks [https://open.spotify.com/episode/3c9Q2gIDqcP8UzWsafY7Pw?si=C-b8OYbjSwiooCxuBBL91g&nd=1&dlsi=268e4ef73db64dd7] , the Resistor Vic podcast [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RCBwnPDyaj0] , the Blue-Lusional podcast [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sUjymyEWB7I] , KREX [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OvzyQZawFiQ] , the Jazari Kual Show [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zCVBx5Jzo2w] , the Get More Smarter podcast [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cvJlGNLEHVM] , and an Op-ed in the Pagosa Daily Post. [https://pagosadailypost.com/2026/03/13/opinion-western-slope-is-ready-to-move-beyond-political-drama/]
In addition to these events, we’ll be hosting fundraisers and continuing our tour of public events all across the district - showing up, listening, and making sure every community has a voice.
If you’d like to host a Meet & Greet to meet Alex, ask questions, and share your thoughts, please email campaign@alexkelloff.com [campaign@alexkelloff.com] and a member of our team will follow up quickly to discuss scheduling. We’d also be happy to schedule a virtual meet and greet.
We’d love to hear from you — it’s incredibly important that Alex hears from the people he hopes to represent.
What You Can Do

FOLLOW ON SOCIAL MEDIA: Stay up to date with my team at Facebook, [https://www.facebook.com/alexkelloffco/] X [https://x.com/alexkelloffco] , Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/alexkelloffco/] , TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@alexkelloffco] , Bluesky [http://bsky.app/profile/alexkelloffco.bsky.social] and Substack [https://substack.com/@alexkelloffco?]

2. VOLUNTEER: Sign up to get involved with my campaign » [https://alexkelloff.com/volunteer]

3. FINANCIALLY SUPPORT: Donate to my campaign today » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-ak]

4. HOST A MEET & GREET: Contact campaign@alexkelloff.com [campaign@alexkelloff.com] , and we'll quickly follow up with you to discuss hosting an event.

waiting for Trump to make his move.

Demand Justice is launching a $3 million campaign to stop his next Supreme
Court nominee — before one is even named.

There’s a real possibility of one — or more — Supreme Court vacancies this
year. And with the real chance that Democrats flip the Senate in November,
Trump’s window to install another handpicked loyalist could close fast.

So he’ll act. Quickly. The question is whether we’re ready to stop him.

We are.

Demand Justice is leading the charge — building a nationwide campaign now
to expose, oppose, and defeat Trump’s shortlist before a vacancy is even
announced. We’re uniting a team of experts, organizers, and grassroots
supporters across the progressive movement to be ready on day one.

Hey folks,
**Jack Cocchiarella** and I dug into Trump's meltdown, the cracks spreading across MAGA, and the one race that might quietly blow the whole thing open. We got into the money, the fear, the infighting--and yeah, some stuff that's been sitting just under the surface for a while.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] Trump goes all-in to take down Thomas Massie--and still might lose. What that says about his grip on the party right now.
* [**00:06:45**] The "death by a thousand cuts" theory: how Trump's power doesn't collapse all at once--but might be closer than it looks.
* [**00:10:32**] Marjorie Taylor Greene crosses a line--and exposes something deeper inside MAGA that can't be ignored.
* [**00:18:10**] Tucker, Megyn, and the influencer class turn on Trump--what's real, what's opportunism, and what comes next.
* [**00:24:56**] The MAGA coalition fractures into three camps--and why that could turn Trump into a lame duck faster than anyone expected.

This conversation covers a lot: the Massey primary as a proxy war inside MAGA, the role of billionaire money, the growing divide among right-wing influencers, and the dangerous places some of this rhetoric is heading. But more than anything, it's about power--who has it, who's losing it, and what happens when fear starts to fade. If you're trying to understand where this is all going, this is essential listening. And if you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.

I knew the risks of speaking out, but I had an obligation as a veteran who swore to uphold and defend the Constitution to speak directly to our servicemen and women before it was too late. The Republican National Committee immediately attacked me. **Trump called me a traitor. He threatened arrest, prosecution — and even death. His supporters called for me to be hanged.** The FBI and the Justice Department both launched bogus, politically-motivated investigations. They even convened a grand jury to seek a criminal indictment against me. I didn't back down. Not for one second. And that grand jury? They refused to indict me because I did nothing wrong. **But that hasn’t stopped the attacks against me.** The RNC has put a target on my back and they’re churning out lies calling me seditious for my adherence to the Constitution. I refuse to back down from this fight. Because it’s a fight we can’t lose. But I’m facing a massive, MAGA propaganda campaign. Hi, friend, it's Deb, and I'm so excited to introduce you to the newest member of my family and of the Team Haaland pack: **Zia**!
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk552-fr-nd&t=2&akid=8854%2E400544%2E6nI-iN)
I rescued her and named her after the iconic Zia sun — an emblem New Mexicans are proud of and one you can find everywhere in our state, from our state flag and license plates to my own campaign logo.
The Zia sun is a sacred symbol to the Indigenous people of Zia Pueblo. It holds deep beauty and significance for our state, for our people, and for me. It also reflects something special about New Mexico — the way we look out for one another and care for our communities.

As someone who comes from 35 generations of Laguna Pueblo women, that spirit guides how I live, how I lead, and how I’m running this campaign — because I want to make sure every New Mexican has the chance to thrive.
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk552-fr-nd&t=3&akid=8854%2E400544%2E6nI-iN)
---
I have never forgotten my roots, friend, and I never will.

I was once a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy. That’s when I knew I wanted to make sure government and our leaders worked for the people — not the other way around.

So I became an organizer, then chair of the Democratic Party of New Mexico, one of the first Native women elected to Congress, and later the first Native Cabinet secretary.

Every step of the way, I’ve stayed true to who I’ve always been: a fighter and a protector for New Mexicans.

And that will never change.
I am ready to fight for higher wages, lower costs, safer neighborhoods, and strong education for your children. I am ready to push back when Trump wants to drag his dangerous, extremist ideas to New Mexico. I am ready to be the governor New Mexico needs.

But I can’t do it alone. That’s why I have an incredible campaign team, it’s why I have Zia, and friend, it’s why I am reaching out to you. I don't have the means to self-fund my campaign like many of my opponents do, but I do have tens of thousands of folks like you who believe that New Mexico needs a governor who will fight fiercely for our home and our people.
_[Our average online donation this month is just $30.57.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7934?refcode=jtk552-fr-nd&t=4&akid=8854%2E400544%2E6nI-iN)_ That means this campaign is powered by a steady stream of people-powered support that allows us to build momentum across our beautiful state and win.
**So on this special day, as we welcome Zia to our family and this grassroots team, I am humbly asking:_[Will you please chip in $30.57 or anything you can today to support our campaign?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7934?refcode=jtk552-fr-nd&t=5&akid=8854%2E400544%2E6nI-iN)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk552-fr-nd&t=6&akid=8854%2E400544%2E6nI-iN)
---
Be Fierce,

Deb

body:
Come celebrate Earth Day with me 🌍 | |
---
|
---
Hi friends —

In case you didn’t catch Kalliana’s note earlier this week — Earth Month is here, and I have been thinking a lot about what this moment means.

Climate has been at the center of everything I’ve done in public life. From my time as Rhode Island’s first Director of Food Strategy, to passing Providence’s carbon neutrality ordinance on City Council, to running for Lieutenant Governor because I believe we need a LG’s office that actually fights for our clean energy future — this is the work I love.

And Earth Day is my favorite day to actually celebrate that work alongside the people who care about it most.

**[Will you join me?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rq3T8KZTSnu9Ewae5Af8znQ7NVaDv-u7Vi8dpw8g7ehDRkVGvFJqu4Ed5T8nrSWC3PvkyGrh1VvOSfOQKbsytFWzHHB0fiO7QiwMOb3uIx5ojMFeILsIIxn_Y-4UFoOVl61Be7sVoQ9MiS-CpiNKh6CkHKGg1_epgAXsit7FkTARJm0FRCXCWr8lfNeF7CB4g5Ig952vy_c6asonpXKJED_yP9rutgPMvsza4HMcItEwvMSqxqyoxJwERZCUS0Ey2_ApyhLXJkSl0j_pp9syezHOZymi5l3BBwwlfztc6Z0q-nHps7hyhcneDz11K8xxgQp7Pk1PrKMb_-ROM4SyBNFy_6WeV4T9r8R4pAM5eQ2HAjIUWBQmjalbEp5Nhsw4/4pn/rn2vmD1jR5eNXVbMCDbCuA/h0/h001.jJ-6zE27shKXtfU4o5ZgOMQKaksFpyyPIsU9LgtD1gs)**

| [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rq3T8KZTSnu9Ewae5Af8znQ7NVaDv-u7Vi8dpw8g7ehDRkVGvFJqu4Ed5T8nrSWAW4mMHafiD9FkfWt6UaAWHxwU44YGHsCM4I5NXfXNwvfUUy5o2QUXV7uPjWcpvSm5oTfKnJDEO39r-7Ton6vw2c2b37qEBz_5kvzi8k_VhY4br4OOQPur6HX0TZdmhVyXu-081mot-pQkjpzAi-2axRcHqv6kHOW1-GK15zUXylEVnN_vAsYcApg52TIZ_Fbm91YZOYxKmcniVjjPNLavAPlaxcdioBNbvlFwQuqdElT2pj_nHEReDEXUMK6G9YQ7n8qJlT6X3GVG7ElEy_ht-4_lBJn8Q7MxSX7tLs0-yPvf8Ln3whtFyZJnyr-e3yKY/4pn/rn2vmD1jR5eNXVbMCDbCuA/h1/h001.oevpQSE1LCA-bKy3ZCMdguM-VEQ1I8UyX_KoB1Qxbv8) Let’s get the pollinator garden ready for spring! Spread woodchips, tidy up the garden, and enjoy a morning of community in one of NBG’s best spots with Martha and Margaret, the pollinator garden stewards, and Sue AnderBois, Ward 3's city council representative.

Meet at the Rochambeau Gate and park on North Main Street.

We'll have most of the supplies you'll need, but bring your favorite gloves, and a rake if you really love yours. | | [ **RSVP HERE** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rq3T8KZTSnu9Ewae5Af8znQ7NVaDv-u7Vi8dpw8g7ehDRkVGvFJqu4Ed5T8nrSWAW4mMHafiD9FkfWt6UaAWHxwU44YGHsCM4I5NXfXNwvacfY73WXGY-7CRuvsQM1Jhg-hCK5fJs8SkfZiyMPWKIuLi4p6RE-LOQ89GJ4wqjjV43FXUrWkr4Y1GowkhmFU3QhGACeOKgVUMYTucPa0pqhyOdfnpCjM1rAiif1ILizaPvFDkncw3dy8f_M7rpTSguX3vUZaS8s8LN4e2VFkETaecSCq42dfxglqaSox3ZgY-BSSTf1zT89gSMs1Q3ybWNIzTOUPROM_CS3uo35j5AER-G9IPDpvHM38jERNietSYo9Wkx7HgQc56AX0DCsyE/4pn/rn2vmD1jR5eNXVbMCDbCuA/h2/h001.U_ymlmez3VIiG4aHDGreS7B9yGeNdj8211nRDGB0_jU)
---

I’ll have more details very soon — but I wanted to get it on your radar now. This is exactly the kind of event that reminds me why this campaign matters: **[Rhode Islanders who care about our future, showing up together.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rq3T8KZTSnu9Ewae5Af8znQ7NVaDv-u7Vi8dpw8g7ehDRkVGvFJqu4Ed5T8nrSWC3PvkyGrh1VvOSfOQKbsytFWzHHB0fiO7QiwMOb3uIx98VFTCH6jAlaYQpyGStjJ1Z5WWNAtlYf1jcr17yRH-qngxz4ZYtfX341ueAqDE-70cZ1oPoP3N07zcez_mfNd6llWEV9OKsm70RDSUqL4hays921SwRJZJYouu3UoLk0BhrQ-WNIUiqZaT4J1eOqeBaJAt0PUlzl5OQF9ILb8Q0ZRKRDBsQJdyyEjomTviyIHyZ7JqqCiEK97Z8yR_QP95ZxutE8Roo4MD6aCNjX6de2xUebabTjSx2GSyO6rXnzVZmQwI5sk8_9UtuBshm1iA/4pn/rn2vmD1jR5eNXVbMCDbCuA/h3/h001.0Hl_NofgWBcibKMlDEXYzsgcT3akyKSHmxIHAuZqpHc)**

I hope to see you there.

With gratitude,

Sue

_P.S. If you missed Kalliana’s Earth Month media roundup from earlier this week, it’s worth a read — she put together some of my favorite press coverage that I think captures where this campaign is coming from and where it’s headed. Check it out!_ 🌱
**Begin forwarded message:**
> ****
> Hi friends!
>
> It’s Kalliana, Sue’s campaign manager. I wanted to reach out with an update that’s really important to all of us here at Team AnderBois.
>
> Earth Day is coming up, and we can’t think of a better way to celebrate than by sharing a few pieces that show exactly who Sue is and why she’s the right person to bring real climate & environmental leadership to the Lieutenant Governor’s office.
>
> Sue is not new to this work. Long before she was running for statewide office. Long before the City Council. She has been one of Rhode Island’s most dedicated climate and food policy advocates for a long time — and people have noticed.
>
> So in the spirit of Earth Month, here’s a little media roundup of some of Sue’s top climate hits 👇
>
> **Rhode Island PBS — Earth Week Feature** A few years back (see, I told you she’s not new to this!), Rhode Island PBS spotlighted Sue as part of their Earth Week programming, and it’s honestly one of my favorite things to share with people who are just getting to know Sue and what she stands for.

Climate has been at the center of everything I’ve done in public life. From my time as Rhode Island’s first Director of Food Strategy, to passing Providence’s carbon neutrality ordinance on City Council, to running for Lieutenant Governor because I believe we need a LG’s office that actually fights for our clean energy future — this is the work I love. And Earth Day is my favorite day to actually celebrate that work alongside the people who care about it most. | Let’s get the pollinator garden ready for spring! Spread woodchips, tidy up the garden, and enjoy a morning of community in one of NBG’s best spots with Martha and Margaret, the pollinator garden stewards, and Sue AnderBois, Ward 3's city council representative. Meet at the Rochambeau Gate and park on North Main Street. We'll have most of the supplies you'll need, but bring your favorite gloves, and a rake if you really love yours. | | I’ll have more details very soon — but I wanted to get it on your radar now. This is exactly the kind of event that reminds me why this campaign matters: I hope to see you there. With gratitude, Sue P.S. So in the spirit of Earth Month, here’s a little media roundup of some of Sue’s top climate hits 👇 Rhode Island PBS — Earth Week Feature A few years back (see, I told you she’s not new to this!), Rhode Island PBS spotlighted Sue as part of their Earth Week programming, and it’s honestly one of my favorite things to share with people who are just getting to know Sue and what she stands for. As RI’s first-ever governor-appointed Director of Food Strategy (she was the first in the entire country, by the way 🤯), she laid out a real, actionable vision for how our food and energy systems could strengthen communities and protect our future. | "Her passionate advocacy guides policy and public awareness, providing a clear vision for food and energy for Rhode Island." — Rhode Island PBS --- | --- Steve Ahlquist (Substack) — Interview: Why Sue Is Running Journalist Steve Ahlquist sat down with Sue for an in-depth conversation about why she’s making this run for higher office, and how she plans to use the Lt. # Trump hits 11 months of ZERO border releases
The Trump administration has recorded **[11 consecutive months with zero migrant releases into the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/364ab081-59bf-46bf-bee7-2574e288f35f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from the southern border, as March saw only 8,268 Border Patrol arrests.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/364ab081-59bf-46bf-bee7-2574e288f35f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Eleven Months Zero Releases:** U.S. Border Patrol has gone 11 straight months without releasing any migrants into the country, reversing Biden-era catch-and-release policies that fueled the border surge.
* **March Records Low Arrests:** Border Patrol made 8,268 arrests in March with a daily average of 267, marking the 14th consecutive month with fewer than 9,000 southwest border arrests.
* **Sharp Decline From Peak:** March arrest totals were 97 percent below the December 2023 peak and 90 percent below the monthly average over the last 33 years.
* **New Normal Under Trump:** Officials credit America First policies for the results, with Assistant DHS Secretary Lauren Bis noting they only needed a new President to secure the border without new laws.

* * *
# Trump considers punishing disloyal NATO allies
The Trump administration is considering **[punishing NATO nations that failed to fully support](https://substack.com/redirect/b8e9697e-5b73-4d41-bf4b-54f0345713f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the U.S. military operation against Iran by reducing American troops and shifting resources away from them.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8e9697e-5b73-4d41-bf4b-54f0345713f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Supportive nations may gain troop presence:** Countries such as Greece, Lithuania, Poland, and Romania could see an increased American military footprint due to their supportive stance during the Iran conflict.
* **The cuts:** Germany and Spain are cited as potentially losing U.S. resources, with Spain refusing U.S. access to bases and airspace and failing defense spending targets. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz called the conflict a massive escalation not their war while President Frank-Walter Steinmeier labeled it a disastrous mistake breaching international law.

name: Matthew Davis, LCV
subject: TELL CONGRESS: Save the EPA and Low Income Home Energy
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM2MjE5MDAS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ0MDA3Nzc1NwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Tell Congress:
Save the EPA and Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program

This week, Trump released his budget for 2027, and it includes massive cuts to
social, environmental, and clean energy programs. He wants to eliminate the Low
Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP), which helps millions of
struggling families pay their energy bills, and cut the EPA budget IN HALF.

We cannot allow this to happen. Join LCV and tell your member of Congress to
protect the EPA, LIHEAP, and other essential programs that keep our communities
safe and affordable.

Tell Congress: Save the EPA from Trump’s egregious budget cuts! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT-_ ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, Trump released his proposed budget for the federal government this week and it
is even more destructive than we imagined. This budget would slash social programs, prop up dirty fossil fuels, and gut the
EPA even further, cutting its funding by 52%. It would eliminate the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) which is essential for
helping millions of struggling families pay their heating and cooling bills —
costs that have already been skyrocketing thanks to Trump and extreme
congressional Republicans. This budget must not pass. Tell your member of Congress to protect people and keep funding the EPA and LIHEAP. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/pNy7f3ymb_ This proposed budget fails to address the skyrocketing costs of groceries,
housing, or energy across the country. But it does escalate the extreme cuts
this administration and Congressional Republicans have already enacted that will
lead to more pollution in our air and water, put the health of our communities
at risk, and make basic needs even more expensive. Instead of prioritizing lowering energy costs for hardworking families, Trump is
focused on creating a global energy crisis. Instead of propping up expensive, polluting fossil fuels, we should be investing
in affordable clean energy, which is the fastest and cheapest way to tackle
skyrocketing bills and meet rising energy demand. We urge Congress to work
together to do just that. Sign your name and tell your member of Congress SAY NO to Trump’s 2027 Budget. https://links.messages.lcv. Thank you for being with us, Peter. Matthew Davis
Vice President of Federal Policy
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. body:
The opposition is pouring millions more into this race before Election Day on April 21.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260409-478&t=1&akid=478%2E12592%2EgKrZO7)
This is a bit of a longer email, but we promise it’s critically important. That being said, it would mean a lot to us if you read all the way to the end.
**The NO campaign against the critical redistricting amendment in Virginia just got** **_another $9 million influx of MAGA dark money_**.
[](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260409_3.B4uXMq&amount=3&refcode=20260409-478&t=2&akid=478%2E12592%2EgKrZO7)
That brings their fundraising total to **over $22 million**. **$19 million of that in the last two weeks alone.**
We’re being outraised in a big way. And it’s not a mystery why. Trump, MAGA Republicans, and billionaires like Peter Thiel are coalescing to stop the Virginia redistricting amendment because they _know_ Virginia can keep Trump from rigging the 2026 midterms in his favor.
[**Help us fight back against Trump’s power grabs, and protect Virginians' voting rights by rushing a donation of $3 or more right now >>>**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260409_3.B4uXMq&amount=3&refcode=20260409-478&t=3&akid=478%2E12592%2EgKrZO7)
If Republicans block this amendment? **Trump’s MAGA Republican allies will be able to dilute Virginians’ collective voice and stack the deck in their favor.**
If the YES campaign for redistricting in Virginia prevails and we pass this amendment? **We can protect Virginians, take back the House in the 2026 midterms, and keep Trump in check.**
It all comes down to this. Early voting is already underway, and Election Day is quickly approaching on April 21. The NO campaign is going to buy up as much TV ad space as they can with their new $9 million cash infusion.
That means Virginians who have never heard about the upcoming special election may learn about it through Republicans’ misinformation and lies.
Not everyone cares as much about politics as you do, and it’s absolutely essential that we have the resources to cut through the NO campaign’s noise to inform voters across the Commonwealth of the _truth_ about this critical redistricting amendment.
[**Can we count on you to chip in $3 or anything you can right now?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260409_3.B4uXMq&amount=3&refcode=20260409-478&t=4&akid=478%2E12592%2EgKrZO7)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260409_3.B4uXMq&amount=3&refcode=20260409-478&t=23&akid=478%2E12592%2EgKrZO7)**
We refuse to let the NO campaign and their mega donors buy this election, but we’re going to need the full power of this grassroots movement to stop them.
Thanks for your support during this critical time,
Virginians For Fair Elections

[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_vafe_2026_footer?refcode=em&t=24&refcode2=478_12592_gKrZO7&akid=478%2E12592%2EgKrZO7)

I’ve stood up to extremists — including Tina Peters and Donald Trump — before, and I’ll do it again to keep our elections safe and secure.

— Jena

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240788%2E444211%2Ebaa1Ta)
UTRGV Edinburg, what a wonderful day yesterday!! The light rain was cool cover for our PXP volunteers and the College Dems as we met, registered and committed to stay in touch with hundreds of students who stopped by our campus field tent.
I’m grateful for a box of cosmic brownies, a cup of fruit with chamoy and other small sweet gifts of welcome.
Edinburg Mayor Omar Ochoa came to say hello as did the incoming UTRGV student body president.
I was asked by students about how we talk to our relatives who voted for Trump (listen to them, seek to understand how they see things and look for common ground — we can’t afford to write them off based on how they voted last time), how the Valley can get the respect it deserves (vote in such numbers that the people in power are truly afraid of the power of the people) and how we balance border security and border identity (a young man from Progreso told me about his desire to be generous to migrants but worried about his family when they cross into his property. We discussed the need for those in DC to rewrite our immigration laws so that there are safe, legal and orderly pathways for people to come here through our ports of entry and not between them).
Someone else asked how can Democrats get this done? I said let the people of the border lead on this. We live this and understand it better than anyone else. I trust the people of Edinburg, Laredo, Eagle Pass, Del Rio, El Paso to ensure we remain a country strengthened by immigrants and one that respects the rule of law.
Students also signed up to join Powered by People, to help us in our mission of registering and turning out the young Texas voters who represent the margin of victory in November.
More soon,
Beto
Thanks to this grassroots team, we're running incredible voter registration and organizing programs — reaching Texans where they are.
**But scaling up to meet this moment ahead of Election Day in November will take sustained work, people power, and resources.**

# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260409-2705)
Peter,
If we’re serious about building a government that works for working people, we need leaders who have actually lived the struggle and are willing to fight to change it.
That’s why I’m proud to endorse**Francesca Hong for Governor of Wisconsin.**
[**Before I explain, will you rush a contribution to support Fran today?**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260409.aqlDOj&refcode=em20260409-2705&t=1&akid=2705%2E105371%2EyjNXQs)
[****](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260409.aqlDOj&refcode=em20260409-2705&t=2&akid=2705%2E105371%2EyjNXQs)
Fran Hong isn’t a career politician. **She’s a working mom. A restaurant worker. A chef.**
She’s lived paycheck to paycheck. She’s had to make tough choices about childcare, groceries, and keeping the lights on.
And she’s never forgotten what that feels like.
In the Wisconsin State Assembly, Fran has become one of the most unapologetic voices for working families:
* Fighting for **BadgerCare for All** so healthcare is a right
* Leading efforts to **abolish the tipped minimum wage**
* Writing legislation to provide **healthy school meals for every student**
* **Standing up** to corporate greed and **defending** public education

She doesn’t just talk about economic justice—she’s been leading the fight for it.
Now she’s running for Governor to take that fight statewide: Universal childcare, paid family leave, strong public schools, and lower costs for working families and small businesses.
But here’s the reality: Candidates like Fran—who challenge corporate power and the status quo—can’t compete without grassroots support from people like you.
And in a race this big, early support can make all the difference.
If we want more leaders who understand the struggle and refuse to back down, we have to step up right now.
[**Will you join me and chip in what you can to support a working-class fighter in Wisconsin?**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260409.aqlDOj&refcode=em20260409-2705&t=3&akid=2705%2E105371%2EyjNXQs)
Thank you for your support, your activism, and everything that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro Khanna

subject: We will not stay silent
body:
DACA is being systematically dismantled. We’re here to stop it. | | | Peter, For years, the DACA program has been systematically weakened and put at risk. Over the next month, we’re taking a deep dive into how the current administration is trying to dismantle the DACA program as we know it. Here are some things you need to know about how the federal government is undermining DACA and how it is harming immigrant youth.
* The administration is trying to weaken or end the benefits DACA recipients have been able to win for themselves, such as cutting off access to the Affordable Care Act, challenging and blocking access to higher education, and even blocking access to commercial driver's licenses.
* Most alarmingly, the administration is trying to undermine DACA by urging DACA recipients to self-deport and actively ignoring the protections from detention and deportation that DACA guarantees. Over the next month, we’ll share detailed information about all of these measures that are harming our community.

**We cannot let this happen.** These are not isolated incidents; they serve as warnings of the escalating and threatening landscape we face and the risks to temporary programs like DACA. We’ll continue working to protect not only DACA recipients, but all immigrant youth who have not been able to take advantage of the policy. [**This moment demands that we come together to protect everyone in our communities, Peter. clean_body: DACA is being systematically dismantled. We’re here to stop it. | | | Peter, For years, the DACA program has been systematically weakened and put at risk. Over the next month, we’re taking a deep dive into how the current administration is trying to dismantle the DACA program as we know it. Here are some things you need to know about how the federal government is undermining DACA and how it is harming immigrant youth. The administration is trying to weaken or end the benefits DACA recipients have been able to win for themselves, such as cutting off access to the Affordable Care Act, challenging and blocking access to higher education, and even blocking access to commercial driver's licenses. Most alarmingly, the administration is trying to undermine DACA by urging DACA recipients to self-deport and actively ignoring the protections from detention and deportation that DACA guarantees. Over the next month, we’ll share detailed information about all of these measures that are harming our community. We cannot let this happen. These are not isolated incidents; they serve as warnings of the escalating and threatening landscape we face and the risks to temporary programs like DACA. We’ll continue working to protect not only DACA recipients, but all immigrant youth who have not been able to take advantage of the policy. Thank you for stepping up and joining us at such a crucial time. We’re here, we’re organizing, and we’re facing this moment together. — Nico, United We Dream | Follow us on: | | | | |

Peter,

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, I’ve been thinking a lot about the courage of our Founding Fathers.

250 years ago, 56 patriots risked everything — their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor — to create the greatest country the world has ever seen. A nation founded on liberty, opportunity, and the God-given rights we still cherish today.

That same spirit of patriotism is what called me to service. **On my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and later became a Navy SEAL.** I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the Constitution and the American way of life my parents taught me to love.

Today, as a proud Minnesotan running for the U.S. Senate, I’m fighting to protect that same legacy. But while Republicans continue standing for the core values that built Minnesota and America — strong families, secure borders, safe streets, free enterprise, and real opportunity — _**the Democratic Party has been overtaken by something completely unrecognizable.**_

| We can’t let them gut health care to pay for a war of choice.

Peter, I wish I had better news to share, but the latest reports out of Washington are deeply disturbing. Republicans have already jacked up the cost of health care for millions of Americans just to pay for tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy. Now, they are looking for ways to fund Donald Trump’s war of choice in Iran — and they’ve set their sights on your health care _**again**_. **According to new reports, the GOP is weighing significant health care cuts specifically to pay for the Iran war.** [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-apr26.zut75R&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260409_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=5326%2E35263%2E-yfOTk) It is a shameful trade-off. They are asking American families to sacrifice their medical security and pay higher out-of-pocket costs to foot the bill for a conflict we should never have been in. We cannot let them prioritize war and tax breaks for the rich over the health and well-being of the American people. clean_body: | We can’t let them gut health care to pay for a war of choice. Peter, I wish I had better news to share, but the latest reports out of Washington are deeply disturbing. Republicans have already jacked up the cost of health care for millions of Americans just to pay for tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy. Now, they are looking for ways to fund Donald Trump’s war of choice in Iran — and they’ve set their sights on your health care again. According to new reports, the GOP is weighing significant health care cuts specifically to pay for the Iran war. It is a shameful trade-off. They are asking American families to sacrifice their medical security and pay higher out-of-pocket costs to foot the bill for a conflict we should never have been in. We cannot let them prioritize war and tax breaks for the rich over the health and well-being of the American people. I’m speaking out against this plan, but I need you with me. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | The math is simple for them: they value military escalation over your family’s checkups. They value tax breaks for the 1% over your prescription drug costs. I’m fighting every single day in the Senate to block these cuts and hold this administration accountable, but I can’t do it without the resources to get our message out and mobilize voters across the country. body:
According to NOTUS, “the Republican National Committee alone has about $100 million more than the Democratic National Committee.”
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3085%2E21716%2EQKBCcy)
Hi, it's Sarah McBride.
I’m reaching out about something important. As we head into this year’s midterms — our first big chance to win back power and put a stop to Trump’s authoritarian agenda — Republicans at the national level currently have a sizable fundraising advantage.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260409-1.kVk6-g&refcode=em20260409-3085&amount=5&t=2&akid=3085%2E21716%2EQKBCcy)
According to NOTUS, _“the Republican National Committee alone has about**$100 million more** than the Democratic National Committee. And the RNC is being boosted by Trump super PAC MAGA, Inc., which by itself has **more than $312 million** in the bank.”_
Republicans’ money is coming from AI executives, crypto billionaires, and other special interests who are interested in making sure the government continues to put their needs ahead of working families.
In contrast, the average online donation to my campaign this year is just**$35.90.** I rely on grassroots donations — not right-wing billionaires — to stay focused on delivering for Delaware, fighting for working families, and holding this administration accountable.
Democrats don’t need to match Republicans’ fundraising numbers, but we do need enough to run strong campaigns and fend off MAGA attacks here in Delaware and across the country.
[**So today I’m asking you to pitch in $5, or any amount you can, to make sure we have the resources we need to flip the House this November.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260409-1.kVk6-g&refcode=em20260409-3085&amount=5&t=3&akid=3085%2E21716%2EQKBCcy)

— Sarah
